title: Atocha Morning Express
setting: A sunlit high-speed rail ticket kiosk inside Madrid Atocha station.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenos días! ¿Adónde viaja usted hoy?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as! Ah-DOHN-deh VYAH-hah oos-TED oy?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning! Where are you traveling today?

choices.text: Quisiera un billete a Sevilla, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Kee-SYEH-rah oon bee-YEH-teh ah seh-VEE-yah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: I'd like a ticket to Seville, please.
choices.feedback: Very polite! 'Quisiera' sounds warm and natural at any ticket counter.

choices.text: ¿A qué hora sale el próximo tren a Toledo?
choices.phonetic: Ah keh OH-rah SAH-leh el PROK-see-mo tren ah to-LEH-do?
choices.english: What time does the next train to Toledo leave?
choices.feedback: Clear and direct question—great for checking schedules first.

nodes.npcText: Perfecto, el AVE a Sevilla sale en veinte minutos. ¿Ida o ida y vuelta?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, el AH-veh ah seh-VEE-yah SAH-leh en VEYN-teh mee-NOO-tos. EE-dah o EE-dah ee VWEL-tah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Perfect, the AVE to Seville leaves in twenty minutes. One-way or round-trip?

choices.text: De ida y vuelta, por favor. Regreso mañana.
choices.phonetic: Deh EE-dah ee VWEL-tah, por fah-VOR. Reh-GREH-so mah-NYAH-nah.
choices.english: Round-trip, please. I'm returning tomorrow.
choices.feedback: Natural phrasing! 'Ida y vuelta' is the exact Spanish term for round-trip.

choices.text: Solo ida, gracias. ¿Tiene ventanilla?
choices.phonetic: SO-lo EE-dah, GRAH-syas. TYEH-neh ven-tah-NEE-yah?
choices.english: One-way only, thanks. Do you have a window seat?
choices.feedback: Great combo—asking for 'ventanilla' secures a window seat.

nodes.npcText: El próximo tren a Toledo sale a las diez y cuarto. ¿Quiere reservar un asiento?
nodes.npcPhonetic: El PROK-see-mo tren ah to-LEH-do SAH-leh ah las DYES ee KWAR-to. KYEH-reh reh-sehr-VAR oon ah-SYEN-to?
nodes.npcEnglish: The next train to Toledo departs at 10:15. Would you like to book a seat?

choices.text: Sí, uno de ida y vuelta para hoy, por favor.
choices.phonetic: See, OO-no deh EE-dah ee VWEL-tah PAH-rah oy, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Yes, one round-trip for today, please.
choices.feedback: Smooth and concise—locals omit repeating 'billete' once it's clear.

choices.text: Sí, solo ida con asiento de ventanilla.
choices.phonetic: See, SO-lo EE-dah kon ah-SYEN-to deh ven-tah-NEE-yah.
choices.english: Yes, one-way with a window seat.
choices.feedback: Clear request! Adding 'por favor' makes it even friendlier.

nodes.npcText: Muy bien, son cuarenta y dos euros. ¿Paga con tarjeta o en efectivo?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Mwee byen, son kwah-REN-tah ee dos EH-oo-ros. PAH-gah kon tar-HEH-tah o en eh-fek-TEE-vo?
nodes.npcEnglish: Very well, that's forty-two euros. Are you paying by card or in cash?

choices.text: Con tarjeta, por favor. ¿De qué andén sale?
choices.phonetic: Kon tar-HEH-tah, por fah-VOR. Deh keh ahn-DEN SAH-leh?
choices.english: By card, please. Which platform does it leave from?
choices.feedback: Spot-on! Asking for 'el andén' right away saves rushing later.

choices.text: Pago en efectivo, aquí tiene.
choices.phonetic: PAH-go en eh-fek-TEE-vo, ah-KEE TYEH-neh.
choices.english: I'll pay in cash, here you go.
choices.feedback: Polite and natural! 'Aquí tiene' is the courteous way to hand over money.

nodes.npcText: Le reservé ventanilla en el coche cuatro. Son veintiocho euros con tarjeta o efectivo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Leh reh-sehr-VEH ven-tah-NEE-yah en el KO-cheh KWAH-tro. Son veyn-tee-O-cho EH-oo-ros kon tar-HEH-tah o eh-fek-TEE-vo.
nodes.npcEnglish: I booked you a window seat in car four. It's twenty-eight euros by card or cash.

choices.text: Con tarjeta, gracias. ¿Cuál es la puerta de embarque?
choices.phonetic: Kon tar-HEH-tah, GRAH-syas. Kwal es lah PWER-tah deh em-BAR-keh?
choices.english: By card, thanks. Which is the boarding gate?
choices.feedback: Excellent practical vocabulary ('puerta de embarque')!

choices.text: En efectivo, por favor. Muchas gracias.
choices.phonetic: En eh-fek-TEE-vo, por fah-VOR. MOO-chas GRAH-syas.
choices.english: In cash, please. Thank you very much.
choices.feedback: Warm, clear, and completely natural at a Spanish rail counter.

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene su billete. Sale del andén tres a la derecha. ¡Buen viaje!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh soo bee-YEH-teh. SAH-leh del ahn-DEN tres ah lah deh-REH-chah. Bwen VYAH-heh!
nodes.npcEnglish: Here is your ticket. It departs from platform three on the right. Have a great trip!

title: Churrería at Dawn
setting: A cozy Madrid café serving thick hot chocolate and fresh churros.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hola, buenos días! ¿Qué le pongo para desayunar?
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-lah, BWEH-nos DEE-as! Keh leh POHN-go PAH-rah deh-sah-yoo-NAR?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hello, good morning! What can I get you for breakfast?

choices.text: Un chocolate con churros, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Oon cho-ko-LAH-teh kon CHOO-rros, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: A hot chocolate with churros, please.
choices.feedback: Classic Madrid order—short, crisp, and totally authentic.

choices.text: Un café con leche y una tostada, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Oon kah-FEH kon LEH-cheh ee OO-nah tos-TAH-dah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: A coffee with milk and toast, please.
choices.feedback: Very natural everyday Spanish breakfast order.

nodes.npcText: ¡Marchando! ¿Prefiere churros finos o porras más grandes?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Mar-CHAN-do! Preh-FYEH-reh CHOO-rros FEE-nos o PO-rras mas GRAN-des?
nodes.npcEnglish: Coming right up! Do you prefer thin churros or larger porras?

choices.text: Churros finos, por favor. ¿Tienen zumo de naranja?
choices.phonetic: CHOO-rros FEE-nos, por fah-VOR. TYEH-nen ZOO-mo deh nah-RAN-hah?
choices.english: Thin churros, please. Do you have orange juice?
choices.feedback: Great use of Spain's 'zumo de naranja' (fresh orange juice).

choices.text: Me gustaría probar las porras, gracias.
choices.phonetic: Meh goos-tah-REE-ah pro-BAR las PO-rras, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: I'd like to try the porras, thanks.
choices.feedback: Curious and polite—locals love when visitors try porras!

nodes.npcText: Estupendo. ¿La tostada con tomate y aceite o con mantequilla y mermelada?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es-too-PEN-do. Lah tos-TAH-dah kon to-MAH-teh ee ah-SEY-teh o kon man-teh-KEE-yah ee mehr-meh-LAH-dah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Great. Toast with tomato and olive oil, or with butter and jam?

choices.text: Con tomate y aceite, por favor. Y un zumo natural.
choices.phonetic: Kon to-MAH-teh ee ah-SEY-teh, por fah-VOR. Ee oon ZOO-mo nah-too-RAL.
choices.english: With tomato and olive oil, please. And a fresh juice.
choices.feedback: Super local! 'Pan con tomate y aceite' is a beloved Spanish staple.

choices.text: Con mantequilla y mermelada, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Kon man-teh-KEE-yah ee mehr-meh-LAH-dah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: With butter and jam, please.
choices.feedback: Polite and clear—easy for any café waiter to follow.

nodes.npcText: ¡Claro! Recién exprimido. ¿Lo toma aquí en la terraza o en la barra?
nodes.npcPhonetic: KLAH-ro! Reh-SYEN eks-pree-MEE-do. Lo TO-mah ah-KEE en lah teh-RRAH-sah o en lah BAH-rrah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Of course! Freshly squeezed. Are you having it on the terrace or at the counter?

choices.text: En la terraza, por favor. Hace muy buen tiempo.
choices.phonetic: En lah teh-RRAH-sah, por fah-VOR. AH-seh mwee bwen TYEM-po.
choices.english: On the terrace, please. The weather is lovely.
choices.feedback: Friendly small talk ('hace muy buen tiempo') fits café culture wonderfully.

choices.text: Aquí en la barra está perfecto, gracias.
choices.phonetic: Ah-KEE en lah BAH-rrah es-TAH pehr-FEK-to, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: Here at the counter is perfect, thanks.
choices.feedback: Very Madrid! Standing or sitting at 'la barra' is fast and economical.

nodes.npcText: Enseguida se lo traigo bien calentito. ¿Desea un vaso de agua también?
nodes.npcPhonetic: En-seh-GEE-dah seh lo TRY-go byen kah-len-TEE-to. Deh-SEH-ah oon VAH-so deh AH-gwah tam-BYEN?
nodes.npcEnglish: I'll bring it right out nice and hot. Would you like a glass of water too?

choices.text: Sí, un vaso de agua del tiempo, por favor.
choices.phonetic: See, oon VAH-so deh AH-gwah del TYEM-po, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Yes, a glass of room-temperature water, please.
choices.feedback: Impressive! 'Agua del tiempo' is the exact Spanish idiom for room-temp water.

choices.text: No, así está muy bien, muchas gracias.
choices.phonetic: No, ah-SEE es-TAH mwee byen, MOO-chas GRAH-syas.
choices.english: No, that's plenty, thank you very much.
choices.feedback: Gracious way to decline an extra item politely.

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene su desayuno recién hecho. ¡Que aproveche!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh soo deh-sah-YOO-no reh-SYEN EH-cho. Keh ah-pro-VEH-cheh!
nodes.npcEnglish: Here is your freshly made breakfast. Enjoy your meal!

title: Mercado de San Miguel
setting: A lively Madrid tapas stall lined with olives, croquetas, and jamón.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenas tardes! Tenemos croquetas recién hechas y aceitunas rellenas. ¿Qué le apetece?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nas TAR-des! Teh-NEH-mos kro-KEH-tas reh-SYEN EH-chas ee ah-sey-TOO-nas reh-YEH-nas. Keh leh ah-peh-TEH-seh?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good afternoon! We have freshly made croquetas and stuffed olives. What sounds good?

choices.text: Me pone dos croquetas de jamón, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Meh PO-neh dos kro-KEH-tas deh hah-MON, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Could I get two ham croquetas, please.
choices.feedback: Spot-on! 'Me pone...' is how Spaniards naturally order at tapas bars.

choices.text: Quiero probar las aceitunas, por favor.
choices.phonetic: KYEH-ro pro-BAR las ah-sey-TOO-nas, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: I want to try the olives, please.
choices.feedback: Friendly and clear; 'me gustaría probar' is slightly softer if you like.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buena elección! Son crujientes por fuera y suaves por dentro. ¿Algo más para picar?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nah eh-lek-SYON! Son kroo-HYEN-tes por FWEH-rah ee SWAH-ves por DEN-tro. AL-go mas PAH-rah pee-KAR?
nodes.npcEnglish: Great choice! They're crispy outside and creamy inside. Anything else to snack on?

choices.text: Sí, una ración pequeña de queso manchego.
choices.phonetic: See, OO-nah rah-SYON peh-KEH-nyah deh KEH-so man-CHEH-go.
choices.english: Yes, a small portion of Manchego cheese.
choices.feedback: Excellent! 'Una ración' is the key word for shareable tapas plates.

choices.text: No, solo las croquetas por ahora, gracias.
choices.phonetic: No, SO-lo las kro-KEH-tas por ah-O-rah, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: No, just the croquetas for now, thanks.
choices.feedback: Natural and polite—keeps things light while exploring the market.

nodes.npcText: Estas están rellenas de anchoa y pimiento. ¿Quiere media ración o una tapa?
nodes.npcPhonetic: ES-tas es-TAN reh-YEH-nas deh an-CHO-ah ee pee-MYEN-to. KYEH-reh MEH-dyah rah-SYON o OO-nah TAH-pah?
nodes.npcEnglish: These are stuffed with anchovy and pepper. Would you like a half-portion or a tapa?

choices.text: Una tapa de aceitunas y un poco de queso, por favor.
choices.phonetic: OO-nah TAH-pah deh ah-sey-TOO-nas ee oon PO-ko deh KEH-so, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: A tapa of olives and a little cheese, please.
choices.feedback: Very natural pairing and clear portion request.

choices.text: Solo una tapa pequeña, por favor.
choices.phonetic: SO-lo OO-nah TAH-pah peh-KEH-nyah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Just a small tapa, please.
choices.feedback: Simple and polite—works at every stall in the market.

nodes.npcText: ¡Estupendo! ¿Le acompaño esto con una caña o con un agua con gas?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es-too-PEN-do! Leh ah-kom-PAH-nyo ES-to kon OO-nah KAH-nyah o kon oon AH-gwah kon gas?
nodes.npcEnglish: Wonderful! Shall I pair that with a small draft beer or sparkling water?

choices.text: Un agua con gas bien fría, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Oon AH-gwah kon gas byen FREE-ah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: A nice cold sparkling water, please.
choices.feedback: Very natural! 'Bien fría' is how locals ask for ice-cold drinks.

choices.text: Una caña, por favor. ¿Cuánto es todo?
choices.phonetic: OO-nah KAH-nyah, por fah-VOR. KWAN-to es TO-do?
choices.english: A small draft beer, please. How much is everything?
choices.feedback: Great flow—ordering and asking for the total in one breath.

nodes.npcText: Perfecto, así prueba varios puestos del mercado. ¿Necesita una bebida?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, ah-SEE PRWEH-bah VAH-ryos PWES-tos del mehr-KAH-do. Neh-seh-SEE-tah OO-nah beh-BEE-dah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Perfect, that way you can try several market stalls. Do you need a drink?

choices.text: Sí, un refresco de limón, por favor.
choices.phonetic: See, oon reh-FRES-ko deh lee-MON, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Yes, a lemon soda, please.
choices.feedback: Very natural! 'Refresco' is the standard word for soft drink.

choices.text: No, gracias. ¿Cuánto le debo?
choices.phonetic: No, GRAH-syas. KWAN-to leh DEH-bo?
choices.english: No, thanks. How much do I owe you?
choices.feedback: Polite and idiomatic way to ask for the bill at a stall.

nodes.npcText: Son ocho euros con cincuenta. ¡Disfrute mucho del mercado!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Son O-cho EH-oo-ros kon seen-KWEN-tah. Dees-FROO-teh MOO-cho del mehr-KAH-do!
nodes.npcEnglish: That's eight euros fifty. Enjoy the market!

title: Plaza Mayor Directions
setting: Asking a friendly bookseller near Madrid's Plaza Mayor for directions.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hola! Parece que busca algo en el mapa. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-lah! Pah-REH-seh keh BOOS-kah AL-go en el MAH-pah. En keh leh PWEH-do ah-yoo-DAR?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hello! It looks like you're looking for something on the map. How can I help?

choices.text: Perdone, ¿dónde está el Palacio Real?
choices.phonetic: Pehr-DO-neh, DOHN-deh es-TAH el pah-LAH-syo reh-AL?
choices.english: Excuse me, where is the Royal Palace?
choices.feedback: Courteous opening ('Perdone') and clear destination question.

choices.text: Disculpe, ¿cómo llego al Parque del Retiro?
choices.phonetic: Dees-KOOL-peh, KO-mo YEH-go al PAR-keh del reh-TEE-ro?
choices.english: Excuse me, how do I get to Retiro Park?
choices.feedback: Excellent! '¿Cómo llego a...?' is super useful for walking directions.

nodes.npcText: Está muy cerca. Siga todo recto por la calle Mayor unos cinco minutos.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es-TAH mwee SEHR-kah. SEE-gah TO-do REK-to por lah KAH-yeh mah-YOR OO-nos SEEN-ko mee-NOO-tos.
nodes.npcEnglish: It's very close. Go straight ahead down Calle Mayor for about five minutes.

choices.text: ¿Y después giro a la derecha o a la izquierda?
choices.phonetic: Ee des-PWES HEE-ro ah lah deh-REH-chah o ah lah ees-KYEHR-dah?
choices.english: And after that do I turn right or left?
choices.feedback: Great follow-up—confirming the turn avoids getting lost.

choices.text: ¿Se puede ir a pie fácilmente?
choices.phonetic: Seh PWEH-deh eer ah pyeh fah-seel-MEN-teh?
choices.english: Can you walk there easily?
choices.feedback: Good clarifying check using 'ir a pie' (to go on foot).

nodes.npcText: El Retiro está un poco más lejos. Puede ir andando veinte minutos o tomar el metro.
nodes.npcPhonetic: El reh-TEE-ro es-TAH oon PO-ko mas LEH-hos. PWEH-deh eer an-DAN-do VEYN-teh mee-NOO-tos o to-MAR el MEH-tro.
nodes.npcEnglish: Retiro is a bit farther. You can walk twenty minutes or take the metro.

choices.text: Prefiero ir en metro. ¿Cuál es la estación más cercana?
choices.phonetic: Preh-FYEH-ro eer en MEH-tro. Kwal es lah es-tah-SYON mas sehr-KAH-nah?
choices.english: I prefer taking the metro. Which is the closest station?
choices.feedback: Natural and practical—great use of the superlative 'más cercana'.

choices.text: Me apetece caminar. ¿Voy recto por esta calle?
choices.phonetic: Meh ah-peh-TEH-seh kah-mee-NAR. Voy REK-to por ES-tah KAH-yeh?
choices.english: I feel like walking. Do I go straight down this street?
choices.feedback: Very idiomatic! 'Me apetece' sounds genuinely Spanish.

nodes.npcText: Al llegar a la esquina del banco, gire a la derecha y verá la señal enseguida.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Al yeh-GAR ah lah es-KEE-nah del BAN-ko, HEE-reh ah lah deh-REH-chah ee veh-RAH lah seh-NYAL en-seh-GEE-dah.
nodes.npcEnglish: When you reach the corner by the bank, turn right and you'll see the sign right away.

choices.text: Perfecto, ya me ubico. ¡Muchísimas gracias!
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, yah meh oo-BEE-ko. Moo-CHEE-see-mas GRAH-syas!
choices.english: Perfect, I have my bearings now. Thank you so much!
choices.feedback: Awesome idiom! 'Ya me ubico' means 'I've got my bearings now.'

choices.text: Entendido, todo recto y a la derecha. Gracias.
choices.phonetic: En-ten-DEE-do, TO-do REK-to ee ah lah deh-REH-chah. GRAH-syas.
choices.english: Got it, straight ahead and to the right. Thanks.
choices.feedback: Smart habit—repeating directions back confirms you understood.

nodes.npcText: Sí, el paseo es muy agradable y hay sombra casi todo el camino.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, el pah-SEH-o es mwee ah-grah-DAH-bleh ee eye SOM-brah KAH-see TO-do el kah-MEE-no.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, the walk is very pleasant and there is shade almost the entire way.

choices.text: Qué bien, entonces voy paseando. ¡Mil gracias!
choices.phonetic: Keh byen, en-TON-ses voy pah-seh-AN-do. Meel GRAH-syas!
choices.english: How nice, then I'll stroll there. A thousand thanks!
choices.feedback: Warm and lively! '¡Mil gracias!' sounds super friendly.

choices.text: Muchas gracias por su ayuda, que tenga buen día.
choices.phonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas por soo ah-YOO-dah, keh TEN-gah bwen DEE-ah.
choices.english: Thank you very much for your help, have a good day.
choices.feedback: Polite farewell with natural courtesy.

nodes.npcText: ¡De nada! Que disfrute mucho del paseo por Madrid.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Deh NAH-dah! Keh dees-FROO-teh MOO-cho del pah-SEH-o por mah-DREED.
nodes.npcEnglish: You're welcome! Enjoy your walk through Madrid.

title: Sunny Valencia Beach Rentals
setting: A cheerful wooden kiosk renting umbrellas and lounge chairs on Malvarrosa beach.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hola! Hace un sol precioso hoy. ¿Necesitan sombrilla o hamacas?
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-lah! AH-seh oon sol preh-SYO-so oy. Neh-seh-SEE-tan som-BREE-yah o ah-MAH-kas?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hello! It's gorgeous and sunny today. Do you need an umbrella or beach chairs?

choices.text: Sí, quisiera alquilar una sombrilla y dos hamacas.
choices.phonetic: See, kee-SYEH-rah al-kee-LAR OO-nah som-BREE-yah ee dos ah-MAH-kas.
choices.english: Yes, I'd like to rent an umbrella and two beach chairs.
choices.feedback: Spot-on beach vocabulary: 'sombrilla' and 'hamacas'!

choices.text: ¿Cuánto cuesta una sombrilla para toda la tarde?
choices.phonetic: KWAN-to KWES-tah OO-nah som-BREE-yah PAH-rah TO-dah lah TAR-deh?
choices.english: How much is an umbrella for the whole afternoon?
choices.feedback: Smart and clear price question before committing.

nodes.npcText: Muy bien, todo el conjunto cuesta quince euros por el día. ¿Prefieren cerca del mar?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Mwee byen, TO-do el kon-HOON-to KWES-tah KEEN-seh EH-oo-ros por el DEE-ah. Preh-FYEH-ren SEHR-kah del mar?
nodes.npcEnglish: Great, the whole set is fifteen euros for the day. Do you prefer near the water?

choices.text: Sí, en primera fila junto al mar, por favor.
choices.phonetic: See, en pree-MEH-rah FEE-lah HOON-to al mar, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Yes, in the front row by the sea, please.
choices.feedback: Super natural! 'Primera fila' works at beaches and theaters alike.

choices.text: Un poco más atrás está bien, para tener calma.
choices.phonetic: Oon PO-ko mas ah-TRAS es-TAH byen, PAH-rah teh-NEHR KAL-mah.
choices.english: A little farther back is fine, for some peace and quiet.
choices.feedback: Thoughtful and clear explanation in natural Spanish.

nodes.npcText: Una sombrilla sola son seis euros, y cada hamaca cuesta cinco euros.
nodes.npcPhonetic: OO-nah som-BREE-yah SO-lah son seys EH-oo-ros, ee KAH-dah ah-MAH-kah KWES-tah SEEN-ko EH-oo-ros.
nodes.npcEnglish: Just an umbrella is six euros, and each lounge chair is five euros.

choices.text: Genial, me quedo con la sombrilla y una hamaca cerca del agua.
choices.phonetic: Heh-NYAL, meh KEH-do kon lah som-BREE-yah ee OO-nah ah-MAH-kah SEHR-kah del AH-gwah.
choices.english: Great, I'll take the umbrella and one chair near the water.
choices.feedback: Great idiom! 'Me quedo con...' means 'I'll take...'

choices.text: Solo la sombrilla en una zona tranquila, por favor.
choices.phonetic: SO-lo lah som-BREE-yah en OO-nah SO-nah tran-KEE-lah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Just the umbrella in a quiet area, please.
choices.feedback: Polite and concise request.

nodes.npcText: Perfecto, les reservo la parcela siete. ¿A qué hora cierran las duchas? A las ocho.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, les reh-SEHR-vo lah par-SEH-lah SYEH-teh. Ah keh OH-rah SYEH-rran las DOO-chas? Ah las O-cho.
nodes.npcEnglish: Perfect, I'll reserve spot seven for you. In case you wonder, the showers close at eight.

choices.text: ¡Qué útil saberlo! ¿Puedo pagar ahora con tarjeta?
choices.phonetic: Keh OO-teel sah-BEHR-lo! PWEH-do pah-GAR ah-O-rah kon tar-HEH-tah?
choices.english: How helpful to know! Can I pay now by card?
choices.feedback: Very friendly response and clear payment question.

choices.text: Gracias, aquí tiene el dinero en efectivo.
choices.phonetic: GRAH-syas, ah-KEE TYEH-neh el dee-NEH-ro en eh-fek-TEE-vo.
choices.english: Thanks, here's the money in cash.
choices.feedback: Polite and natural cash handoff.

nodes.npcText: Aquí detrás casi no hace viento y se descansa genial. ¿Quiere también una botella de agua fría?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE deh-TRAS KAH-see no AH-seh VYEN-to ee seh des-KAN-sah heh-NYAL. KYEH-reh tam-BYEN OO-nah bo-TEH-yah deh AH-gwah FREE-ah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Back here there's barely any wind and it's great for relaxing. Want a cold bottle of water too?

choices.text: Sí, por favor, una botella grande bien fría.
choices.phonetic: See, por fah-VOR, OO-nah bo-TEH-yah GRAN-deh byen FREE-ah.
choices.english: Yes, please, a large ice-cold bottle.
choices.feedback: Natural and clear—great on a sunny Valencia afternoon.

choices.text: No hace falta, traigo la mía. Muchas gracias.
choices.phonetic: No AH-seh FAL-tah, TRY-go lah MEE-ah. MOO-chas GRAH-syas.
choices.english: No need, I brought mine. Thank you very much.
choices.feedback: Great phrase! 'No hace falta' is the polite way to say 'no need.'

nodes.npcText: Listo, aquí tiene su recibo. ¡Que disfrute mucho de la playa!
nodes.npcPhonetic: LEES-to, ah-KEE TYEH-neh soo reh-SEE-bo. Keh dees-FROO-teh MOO-cho deh lah PLAH-yah!
nodes.npcEnglish: All set, here is your receipt. Enjoy the beach!

title: Corner Panadería
setting: A warm Seville neighborhood bakery filled with the aroma of fresh crusty bread.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenos días! Acaba de salir el pan del horno. ¿Qué le doy hoy?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as! Ah-KAH-bah deh sah-LEER el pan del OR-no. Keh leh doy oy?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning! The bread just came out of the oven. What can I get you today?

choices.text: Una barra de pan crujiente, por favor.
choices.phonetic: OO-nah BAH-rrah deh pan kroo-HYEN-teh, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: A crusty loaf of bread, please.
choices.feedback: Authentic bakery Spanish! 'Una barra de pan' is the everyday staple.

choices.text: ¿Qué dulces típicos me recomienda?
choices.phonetic: Keh DOOL-ses TEE-pee-kos meh reh-ko-MYEN-dah?
choices.english: Which local pastries do you recommend?
choices.feedback: Great conversation starter at a local bakery.

nodes.npcText: ¿La quiere entera o se la corto en rebanadas?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Lah KYEH-reh en-TEH-rah o seh lah KOR-to en reh-bah-NAH-das?
nodes.npcEnglish: Do you want it whole, or shall I slice it for you?

choices.text: En rebanadas, por favor. Así es más cómodo.
choices.phonetic: En reh-bah-NAH-das, por fah-VOR. Ah-SEE es mas KO-mo-do.
choices.english: Sliced, please. That way it's more convenient.
choices.feedback: Great word ('rebanadas') and very natural explanation.

choices.text: Entera está perfecta, gracias.
choices.phonetic: En-TEH-rah es-TAH pehr-FEK-tah, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: Whole is perfect, thanks.
choices.feedback: Short, friendly, and effortless.

nodes.npcText: Hoy tenemos magdalenas caseras y palmeras de chocolate buenísimas.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Oy teh-NEH-mos mag-dah-LEH-nas kah-SEH-ras ee pal-MEH-ras deh cho-ko-LAH-teh bweh-NEE-see-mas.
nodes.npcEnglish: Today we have homemade muffins and delicious chocolate palmiers.

choices.text: Me llevo dos magdalenas y una barra pequeña.
choices.phonetic: Meh YEH-vo dos mag-dah-LEH-nas ee OO-nah BAH-rrah peh-KEH-nyah.
choices.english: I'll take two muffins and a small baguette.
choices.feedback: Very natural! 'Me llevo...' is ideal for takeaway shops.

choices.text: Una palmera de chocolate, por favor.
choices.phonetic: OO-nah pal-MEH-rah deh cho-ko-LAH-teh, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: One chocolate palmier, please.
choices.feedback: Clear and polite order.

nodes.npcText: Enseguida se lo envuelvo todo. ¿Necesita una bolsa de papel?
nodes.npcPhonetic: En-seh-GEE-dah seh lo en-VWEL-vo TO-do. Neh-seh-SEE-tah OO-nah BOL-sah deh pah-PEL?
nodes.npcEnglish: I'll wrap everything right away. Do you need a paper bag?

choices.text: Sí, una bolsa de papel, por favor.
choices.phonetic: See, OO-nah BOL-sah deh pah-PEL, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Yes, a paper bag, please.
choices.feedback: Polite and direct.

choices.text: No gracias, llevo mi propia bolsa de tela.
choices.phonetic: No GRAH-syas, YEH-vo mee PRO-pyah BOL-sah deh TEH-lah.
choices.english: No thanks, I have my own cloth bag.
choices.feedback: Super natural and eco-friendly Spanish!

nodes.npcText: Aquí lo tiene, todavía está tibio. ¿Algo más antes de cobrarle?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE lo TYEH-neh, to-dah-VEE-ah es-TAH TEE-byo. AL-go mas AN-tes deh ko-BRAR-leh?
nodes.npcEnglish: Here you are, it's still warm. Anything else before I ring you up?

choices.text: Eso es todo, gracias. ¿Cuánto es?
choices.phonetic: EH-so es TO-do, GRAH-syas. KWAN-to es?
choices.english: That's all, thanks. How much is it?
choices.feedback: The exact everyday closing phrase used across Spain.

choices.text: Nada más, pago con tarjeta si se puede.
choices.phonetic: NAH-dah mas, PAH-go kon tar-HEH-tah see seh PWEH-deh.
choices.english: Nothing else, I'll pay by card if possible.
choices.feedback: Courteous check ('si se puede') for small bakery purchases.

nodes.npcText: Son tres euros con veinte. ¡Hasta mañana y buen día!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Son tres EH-oo-ros kon VEYN-teh. AH-stah mah-NYAH-nah ee bwen DEE-ah!
nodes.npcEnglish: That's three euros twenty. See you tomorrow and have a good day!

title: Checking Into Casa Sol
setting: A sunlit boutique hotel reception in Granada's historic Albaicín.

nodes.npcText: ¡Bienvenido a Casa Sol! ¿Tiene una reserva a su nombre?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Byen-veh-NEE-do ah KAH-sah Sol! TYEH-neh OO-nah reh-SEHR-vah ah soo NOM-breh?
nodes.npcEnglish: Welcome to Casa Sol! Do you have a reservation under your name?

choices.text: Sí, tengo una reserva para dos noches.
choices.phonetic: See, TEN-go OO-nah reh-SEHR-vah PAH-rah dos NO-ches.
choices.english: Yes, I have a reservation for two nights.
choices.feedback: Clear, polite, and immediately gives the key detail.

choices.text: Sí, reservé por internet. Aquí está mi pasaporte.
choices.phonetic: See, reh-sehr-VEH por een-tehr-NET. Ah-KEE es-TAH mee pah-sah-POR-teh.
choices.english: Yes, I booked online. Here is my passport.
choices.feedback: Very proactive—Spanish hotels always register passport details.

nodes.npcText: Perfecto, ya la encontré. ¿Me presta su pasaporte un momento, por favor?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, yah lah en-kon-TREH. Meh PRES-tah soo pah-sah-POR-teh oon mo-MEN-to, por fah-VOR?
nodes.npcEnglish: Perfect, I found it. Could you hand me your passport for a moment, please?

choices.text: Claro, aquí tiene. ¿El desayuno está incluido?
choices.phonetic: KLAH-ro, ah-KEE TYEH-neh. El deh-sah-YOO-no es-TAH een-kloo-EE-do?
choices.english: Of course, here you go. Is breakfast included?
choices.feedback: Very natural check-in flow!

choices.text: Sí, tome. ¿Cuál es la clave del wifi?
choices.phonetic: See, TO-meh. Kwal es lah KLAH-veh del WEE-fee?
choices.english: Yes, here. What is the Wi-Fi password?
choices.feedback: Useful question; 'clave del wifi' is universally understood.

nodes.npcText: Muchas gracias, todo está confirmado. Su habitación da al patio interior.
nodes.npcPhonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas, TO-do es-TAH kon-feer-MAH-do. Soo ah-bee-tah-SYON dah al PAH-tyo een-teh-RYOR.
nodes.npcEnglish: Thank you very much, everything is confirmed. Your room overlooks the inner courtyard.

choices.text: Qué bonito. ¿A qué hora sirven el desayuno?
choices.phonetic: Keh bo-NEE-to. Ah keh OH-rah SEER-ven el deh-sah-YOO-no?
choices.english: How lovely. What time do you serve breakfast?
choices.feedback: Warm appreciation plus an essential hotel question.

choices.text: Estupendo. ¿Hay ascensor hasta la segunda planta?
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do. Eye ah-sen-SOR AH-stah lah seh-GOON-dah PLAN-tah?
choices.english: Wonderful. Is there an elevator to the second floor?
choices.feedback: Great vocabulary ('ascensor', 'planta').

nodes.npcText: Sí, el desayuno es gratis de ocho a diez y media en la terraza.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, el deh-sah-YOO-no es GRAH-tees deh O-cho ah DYES ee MEH-dyah en lah teh-RRAH-sah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, breakfast is free from eight to ten-thirty on the terrace.

choices.text: Genial, gracias. ¿A qué hora es la salida?
choices.phonetic: Heh-NYAL, GRAH-syas. Ah keh OH-rah es lah sah-LEE-dah?
choices.english: Great, thanks. What time is check-out?
choices.feedback: Smart final question ('la salida' = check-out).

choices.text: Perfecto, muchas gracias por todo.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, MOO-chas GRAH-syas por TO-do.
choices.english: Perfect, thank you very much for everything.
choices.feedback: Polite and pleasant wrap-up.

nodes.npcText: Sí, el ascensor está al fondo y la contraseña del wifi viene escrita en su tarjeta.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, el ah-sen-SOR es-TAH al FON-do ee lah kon-trah-SEH-nyah del WEE-fee VYEH-neh es-KREE-tah en soo tar-HEH-tah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, the elevator is at the back and the Wi-Fi password is written on your key card.

choices.text: Muy amable, gracias. ¿Puedo dejar las maletas mañana?
choices.phonetic: Mwee ah-MAH-bleh, GRAH-syas. PWEH-do deh-HAR las mah-LEH-tas mah-NYAH-nah?
choices.english: Very kind, thanks. Can I leave my bags tomorrow?
choices.feedback: Courteous ('muy amable') and practical for travel days!

choices.text: Estupendo, subo ahora a descansar.
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do, SOO-bo ah-O-rah ah des-kan-SAR.
choices.english: Wonderful, I'll head up now to rest.
choices.feedback: Warm, natural conversational close.

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene su llave, habitación doscientos cuatro. ¡Feliz estancia en Granada!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh soo YAH-veh, ah-bee-tah-SYON dos-SYEN-tos KWAH-tro. Feh-LEES es-TAN-syah en grah-NAH-dah!
nodes.npcEnglish: Here is your key, room 204. Enjoy your stay in Granada!

title: Barcelona Metro Ticket
setting: An information booth inside Passeig de Gràcia metro station.

nodes.npcText: Hola, ¿necesita ayuda con la máquina de billetes del metro?
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-lah, neh-seh-SEE-tah ah-YOO-dah kon lah MAH-kee-nah deh bee-YEH-tes del MEH-tro?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hello, do you need help with the metro ticket machine?

choices.text: Sí, por favor. ¿Qué tarjeta conviene para diez viajes?
choices.phonetic: See, por fah-VOR. Keh tar-HEH-tah kon-VYEH-neh PAH-rah dyes VYAH-hes?
choices.english: Yes, please. Which card is best for ten rides?
choices.feedback: Very idiomatic! '¿Qué conviene...?' is a super natural way to ask what's best.

choices.text: Sí, quiero ir a la Sagrada Familia desde aquí.
choices.phonetic: See, KYEH-ro eer ah lah sah-GRAH-dah fah-MEE-lyah DES-deh ah-KEE.
choices.english: Yes, I want to go to Sagrada Família from here.
choices.feedback: Clear destination—great when you need route advice too.

nodes.npcText: Le conviene la tarjeta T-Casual de diez viajes. Cuesta unos doce euros.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Leh kon-VYEH-neh lah tar-HEH-tah teh-KAH-swal deh dyes VYAH-hes. KWES-tah OO-nos DO-seh EH-oo-ros.
nodes.npcEnglish: The 10-ride T-Casual card is best for you. It costs around twelve euros.

choices.text: ¿Sirve también para el autobús urbano?
choices.phonetic: SEER-veh tam-BYEN PAH-rah el ah-oo-to-BOOS oor-BAH-no?
choices.english: Does it also work on the city bus?
choices.feedback: Smart question using 'servir para' (to work/be valid for).

choices.text: Genial, ¿acepta esta máquina tarjeta sin contacto?
choices.phonetic: Heh-NYAL, ah-SEP-tah ES-tah MAH-kee-nah tar-HEH-tah seen kon-TAK-to?
choices.english: Great, does this machine take contactless card?
choices.feedback: Useful modern transit phrasing.

nodes.npcText: Muy fácil: tome la línea dos morada tres paradas hasta Sagrada Familia.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Mwee FAH-seel: TO-meh lah LEE-neh-ah dos mo-RAH-dah tres pah-RAH-das AH-stah sah-GRAH-dah fah-MEE-lyah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Very easy: take the purple Line 2 three stops to Sagrada Família.

choices.text: ¿Tengo que hacer transbordo o es directo?
choices.phonetic: TEN-go keh ah-SEHR trans-BOR-do o es dee-REK-to?
choices.english: Do I have to transfer or is it direct?
choices.feedback: Top-notch transit vocabulary ('hacer transbordo' = to transfer).

choices.text: Perfecto, compro un billete sencillo aquí mismo.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, KOM-pro oon bee-YEH-teh sen-SEE-yo ah-KEE MEES-mo.
choices.english: Perfect, I'll buy a single ticket right here.
choices.feedback: Clear and accurate ('billete sencillo' = single ride ticket).

nodes.npcText: Sí, sirve para metro y bus, y la línea morada es directa sin transbordo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, SEER-veh PAH-rah MEH-tro ee boos, ee lah LEE-neh-ah mo-RAH-dah es dee-REK-tah seen trans-BOR-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, it works for metro and bus, and the purple line is direct with no transfer.

choices.text: Qué alivio, es facilísimo. ¡Muchas gracias!
choices.phonetic: Keh ah-LEE-vyo, es fah-see-LEE-see-mo. MOO-chas GRAH-syas!
choices.english: What a relief, it's super easy. Thank you very much!
choices.feedback: Expressive and natural! '-ísimo' adds lively emphasis.

choices.text: Entendido, gracias por explicármelo tan bien.
choices.phonetic: En-ten-DEE-do, GRAH-syas por eks-plee-KAR-meh-lo tan byen.
choices.english: Understood, thanks for explaining it so clearly.
choices.feedback: Polite and grateful closing.

nodes.npcText: Sí, solo acerque la tarjeta al lector verde y recoja el billete abajo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, SO-lo ah-SEHR-keh lah tar-HEH-tah al lek-TOR VEHR-deh ee reh-KO-hah el bee-YEH-teh ah-BAH-ho.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, just tap your card on the green reader and collect the ticket below.

choices.text: ¡Ya salió! Gracias por su paciencia.
choices.phonetic: Yah sah-LYO! GRAH-syas por soo pah-SYEN-syah.
choices.english: It came right out! Thank you for your patience.
choices.feedback: Warm and polite!

choices.text: Perfecto, ahora bajo al andén. ¡Adiós!
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, ah-O-rah BAH-ho al ahn-DEN. Ah-DYOS!
choices.english: Perfect, I'll head down to the platform now. Bye!
choices.feedback: Natural and upbeat farewell.

nodes.npcText: ¡De nada! Siga los carteles morados de la línea dos. ¡Buen día!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Deh NAH-dah! SEE-gah los kar-TEH-les mo-RAH-dos deh lah LEE-neh-ah dos. Bwen DEE-ah!
nodes.npcEnglish: You're welcome! Follow the purple signs for Line 2. Have a nice day!

title: Seville Orange-Tree Terrace
setting: A shaded restaurant courtyard beneath fragrant orange trees in Seville.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenas tardes! Tenemos mesa a la sombra bajo los naranjos. ¿Para cuántas personas?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nas TAR-des! Teh-NEH-mos MEH-sah ah lah SOM-brah BAH-ho los nah-RAN-hos. PAH-rah KWAN-tas pehr-SO-nas?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good afternoon! We have a shaded table under the orange trees. For how many people?

choices.text: Una mesa para dos a la sombra, por favor.
choices.phonetic: OO-nah MEH-sah PAH-rah dos ah lah SOM-brah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: A table for two in the shade, please.
choices.feedback: Natural, crisp, and ideal for a warm Andalusian lunch.

choices.text: Soy una persona sola, ¿tienen sitio libre?
choices.phonetic: Soy OO-nah pehr-SO-nah SO-lah, TYEH-nen SEE-tyo LEE-breh?
choices.english: I'm dining alone, do you have a free spot?
choices.feedback: Friendly and clear—'¿tienen sitio?' is super common in Spain.

nodes.npcText: Pasen por aquí. Hoy el menú del día trae gazpacho fresco y pescado a la plancha.
nodes.npcPhonetic: PAH-sen por ah-KEE. Oy el meh-NOO del DEE-ah TRY-eh gas-PAH-cho FRES-ko ee pes-KAH-do ah lah PLAN-chah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Come right this way. Today's daily menu has chilled gazpacho and grilled fish.

choices.text: Suena delicioso. De primero quiero el gazpacho.
choices.phonetic: SWEH-nah deh-lee-SYO-so. Deh pree-MEH-ro KYEH-ro el gas-PAH-cho.
choices.english: Sounds delicious. For the first course I'll have the gazpacho.
choices.feedback: Perfect phrasing! 'De primero' is the exact way to order a first course.

choices.text: ¿Tienen alguna opción vegetariana hoy?
choices.phonetic: TYEH-nen al-GOO-nah op-SYON veh-heh-tah-RYAH-nah oy?
choices.english: Do you have any vegetarian option today?
choices.feedback: Polite and clear dietary question.

nodes.npcText: ¡Claro! Siéntese aquí cerca de la fuente. ¿Le traigo la carta y algo de beber?
nodes.npcPhonetic: KLAH-ro! SYEN-teh-seh ah-KEE SEHR-kah deh lah FWEN-teh. Leh TRY-go lah KAR-tah ee AL-go deh beh-BEHR?
nodes.npcEnglish: Of course! Sit here by the fountain. Shall I bring you the menu and something to drink?

choices.text: Sí, un gazpacho y agua fría, por favor.
choices.phonetic: See, oon gas-PAH-cho ee AH-gwah FREE-ah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Yes, a gazpacho and cold water, please.
choices.feedback: Clean, decisive order!

choices.text: Sí, ¿tienen ensalada o verduras a la plancha?
choices.phonetic: See, TYEH-nen en-sah-LAH-dah o vehr-DOO-ras ah lah PLAN-chah?
choices.english: Yes, do you have salad or grilled vegetables?
choices.feedback: Great vocabulary ('verduras a la plancha').

nodes.npcText: Excelente. El gazpacho está hecho con tomates de huerta. ¿Y de postre querrá fruta o flan?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ek-seh-LEN-teh. El gas-PAH-cho es-TAH EH-cho kon to-MAH-tes deh WEHR-tah. Ee deh POS-treh keh-RRAH FROO-tah o flan?
nodes.npcEnglish: Excellent. The gazpacho is made with garden tomatoes. And for dessert, fruit or flan?

choices.text: Flan casero, por favor. Me encanta.
choices.phonetic: Flan kah-SEH-ro, por fah-VOR. Meh en-KAN-tah.
choices.english: Homemade flan, please. I love it.
choices.feedback: Warm enthusiasm—'me encanta' is a great everyday expression.

choices.text: Prefiero fruta fresca de temporada, gracias.
choices.phonetic: Preh-FYEH-ro FROO-tah FRES-kah deh tem-po-RAH-dah, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: I prefer fresh seasonal fruit, thanks.
choices.feedback: Super natural! 'De temporada' sounds wonderfully idiomatic.

nodes.npcText: Sí, hacemos unas verduras a la plancha riquísimas y tortilla de patatas sin carne.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, ah-SEH-mos OO-nas vehr-DOO-ras ah lah PLAN-chah ree-KEE-see-mas ee tor-TEE-yah deh pah-TAH-tas seen KAR-neh.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, we make delicious grilled vegetables and meatless Spanish potato omelette.

choices.text: Me pido la tortilla y las verduras, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Meh PEE-do lah tor-TEE-yah ee las vehr-DOO-ras, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: I'll order the potato omelette and the vegetables, please.
choices.feedback: Very natural! 'Me pido...' is classic casual restaurant Spanish.

choices.text: Qué buena pinta. Las verduras y un zumo, gracias.
choices.phonetic: Keh BWEH-nah PEEN-tah. Las vehr-DOO-ras ee oon ZOO-mo, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: That sounds amazing. The vegetables and a juice, thanks.
choices.feedback: Awesome idiom! 'Qué buena pinta' means 'looks/sounds tasty!'

nodes.npcText: Oído cocina. En cinco minutos sale su comida bien fresca.
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-EE-do ko-SEE-nah. En SEEN-ko mee-NOO-tos SAH-leh soo ko-MEE-dah byen FRES-kah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Order in! Your fresh meal will be right out in five minutes.

title: Artisan Souvenir Stall
setting: A colorful craft stall selling ceramic tiles and hand-painted fans in Córdoba.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hola! Todo está pintado a mano aquí en Córdoba. ¿Busca un recuerdo especial?
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-lah! TO-do es-TAH peen-TAH-do ah MAH-no ah-KEE en KOR-do-bah. BOOS-kah oon reh-KWEHR-do es-peh-SYAL?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hello! Everything is hand-painted here in Córdoba. Are you looking for a special souvenir?

choices.text: Sí, me encantan estos abanicos pintados a mano.
choices.phonetic: See, meh en-KAN-tan ES-tos ah-bah-NEE-kos peen-TAH-dos ah MAH-no.
choices.english: Yes, I love these hand-painted fans.
choices.feedback: Complimenting the artisan's craft creates instant warmth!

choices.text: Estoy buscando un regalo pequeño para mi familia.
choices.phonetic: Es-TOY boos-KAN-do oon reh-GAH-lo peh-KEH-nyo PAH-rah mee fah-MEE-lyah.
choices.english: I'm looking for a small gift for my family.
choices.feedback: Clear and helpful—lets the shopkeeper suggest great pieces.

nodes.npcText: Gracias. Los de madera de peral duran muchos años. ¿Qué color prefiere?
nodes.npcPhonetic: GRAH-syas. Los deh mah-DEH-rah deh peh-RAL DOO-ran MOO-chos AH-nyos. Keh ko-LOR preh-FYEH-reh?
nodes.npcEnglish: Thank you. The pearwood ones last for many years. Which color do you prefer?

choices.text: Ese azul con flores blancas es precioso. ¿Cuánto vale?
choices.phonetic: EH-seh ah-SOOL kon FLO-res BLAN-kas es preh-SYO-so. KWAN-to VAH-leh?
choices.english: That blue one with white flowers is gorgeous. How much is it?
choices.feedback: Very natural! '¿Cuánto vale?' is used just as often as '¿Cuánto cuesta?'

choices.text: ¿Tiene alguno en rojo o verde oscuro?
choices.phonetic: TYEH-neh al-GOO-no en RO-ho o VEHR-deh os-KOO-ro?
choices.english: Do you have any in red or dark green?
choices.feedback: Great use of 'alguno' to ask about other color options.

nodes.npcText: Estos azulejos con flores son muy ligeros para la maleta y no se rompen fácil.
nodes.npcPhonetic: ES-tos ah-soo-LEH-hos kon FLO-res son mwee lee-HEH-ros PAH-rah lah mah-LEH-tah ee no seh ROM-pen FAH-seel.
nodes.npcEnglish: These floral ceramic tiles are very light for a suitcase and don't break easily.

choices.text: ¡Qué buena idea! ¿Cuánto cuesta cada azulejo?
choices.phonetic: Keh BWEH-nah ee-DEH-ah! KWAN-to KWES-tah KAH-dah ah-soo-LEH-ho?
choices.english: What a great idea! How much does each tile cost?
choices.feedback: Enthusiastic and practical question.

choices.text: ¿Los envuelve bien para viajar en avión?
choices.phonetic: Los en-VWEL-veh byen PAH-rah vyah-HAR en ah-VYON?
choices.english: Do you wrap them well for flying?
choices.feedback: Super smart travel question!

nodes.npcText: Son catorce euros, y si lleva dos se los dejo en veinticinco.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Son kah-TOR-seh EH-oo-ros, ee see YEH-vah dos seh los DEH-ho en veyn-tee-SEEN-ko.
nodes.npcEnglish: It's fourteen euros, and if you take two I'll let you have them for twenty-five.

choices.text: Trato hecho, me llevo dos. ¿Tiene papel de regalo?
choices.phonetic: TRAH-to EH-cho, meh YEH-vo dos. TYEH-neh pah-PEL deh reh-GAH-lo?
choices.english: Deal, I'll take two. Do you have gift wrap?
choices.feedback: Awesome idiom! 'Trato hecho' means 'It's a deal!'

choices.text: Solo necesito uno por hoy, muchas gracias.
choices.phonetic: SO-lo neh-seh-SEE-to OO-no por oy, MOO-chas GRAH-syas.
choices.english: I only need one for today, thank you very much.
choices.feedback: Polite and firm without feeling awkward.

nodes.npcText: Sí, tengo uno verde esmeralda precioso y se lo protejo con doble papel acolchado.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, TEN-go OO-no VEHR-deh es-meh-RAL-dah preh-SYO-so ee seh lo pro-TEH-ho kon DO-bleh pah-PEL ah-kol-CHAH-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, I have a gorgeous emerald green one and I'll protect it with double padded paper.

choices.text: Me encanta ese verde, me lo llevo. Gracias.
choices.phonetic: Meh en-KAN-tah EH-seh VEHR-deh, meh lo YEH-vo. GRAH-syas.
choices.english: I love that green one, I'll take it. Thanks.
choices.feedback: Natural object pronoun ('me lo llevo' = I'll take it)!

choices.text: Perfecto, así llegará sano y salvo a casa.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, ah-SEE yeh-gah-RAH SAH-no ee SAL-vo ah KAH-sah.
choices.english: Perfect, that way it'll make it home safe and sound.
choices.feedback: Great Spanish expression: 'sano y salvo' (safe and sound).

nodes.npcText: Aquí lo tiene bien envuelto. ¡Que disfrute su visita por Córdoba!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE lo TYEH-neh byen en-VWEL-to. Keh dees-FROO-teh soo vee-SEE-tah por KOR-do-bah!
nodes.npcEnglish: Here it is all nicely wrapped. Enjoy your visit to Córdoba!

title: Neighborhood Farmacia
setting: A bright green-cross pharmacy on a quiet corner in Bilbao.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenos días! Bienvenido a la farmacia. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as! Byen-veh-NEE-do ah lah far-MAH-syah. En keh leh PWEH-do ah-yoo-DAR?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning! Welcome to the pharmacy. How can I help you?

choices.text: Necesito crema solar de factor cincuenta, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Neh-seh-SEE-to KREH-mah so-LAR deh fak-TOR seen-KWEN-tah, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: I need SPF 50 sunscreen, please.
choices.feedback: Exact local phrase: 'crema solar' for sunscreen.

choices.text: ¿Tiene algo suave para la alergia al polen?
choices.phonetic: TYEH-neh AL-go SWAH-veh PAH-rah lah ah-LEHR-hyah al PO-len?
choices.english: Do you have something mild for pollen allergy?
choices.feedback: Clear and helpful symptom description for the pharmacist.

nodes.npcText: Claro, tengo en crema o en espray resistente al agua. ¿Es para la cara o el cuerpo?
nodes.npcPhonetic: KLAH-ro, TEN-go en KREH-mah o en es-PRY reh-sees-TEN-teh al AH-gwah. Es PAH-rah lah KAH-rah o el KWEHR-po?
nodes.npcEnglish: Of course, I have lotion or water-resistant spray. Is it for face or body?

choices.text: Para la cara, que sea ligera y sin perfume.
choices.phonetic: PAH-rah lah KAH-rah, keh SEH-ah lee-HEH-rah ee seen pehr-FOO-meh.
choices.english: For the face—something light and fragrance-free.
choices.feedback: Great descriptive details ('ligera', 'sin perfume').

choices.text: En espray para el cuerpo, tamaño de viaje si tienen.
choices.phonetic: En es-PRY PAH-rah el KWEHR-po, tah-MAH-nyo deh VYAH-heh see TYEH-nen.
choices.english: Spray for the body, travel-size if you have it.
choices.feedback: Very practical travel phrase: 'tamaño de viaje'.

nodes.npcText: Sí, estas pastillas sin receta no dan sueño. ¿Tiene picor de ojos también?
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, ES-tas pas-TEE-yas seen reh-SEH-tah no dan SWEH-nyo. TYEH-neh pee-KOR deh O-hos tam-BYEN?
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, these over-the-counter tablets don't cause drowsiness. Do you have itchy eyes too?

choices.text: Un poco, sí. ¿Me recomienda también unas gotas?
choices.phonetic: Oon PO-ko, see. Meh reh-ko-MYEN-dah tam-BYEN OO-nas GO-tas?
choices.english: A little, yes. Do you also recommend some eye drops?
choices.feedback: Very natural follow-up! 'Gotas' works clearly in context.

choices.text: No, solo estornudos. Con las pastillas basta.
choices.phonetic: No, SO-lo es-tor-NOO-dos. Kon las pas-TEE-yas BAS-tah.
choices.english: No, just sneezing. The tablets will be enough.
choices.feedback: Concise and natural—'con ... basta' means '... is enough.'

nodes.npcText: Esta marca dermatológica es muy suave y funciona genial. Se aplica o toma una vez al día.
nodes.npcPhonetic: ES-tah MAR-kah dehr-mah-to-LO-hee-kah es mwee SWAH-veh ee foon-SYO-nah heh-NYAL. Seh ah-PLEE-kah o TO-mah OO-nah ves al DEE-ah.
nodes.npcEnglish: This dermatological brand is very gentle and works great. Use it once a day.

choices.text: Perfecto, me lo llevo. Muchas gracias por el consejo.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, meh lo YEH-vo. MOO-chas GRAH-syas por el kon-SEH-ho.
choices.english: Perfect, I'll take it. Thank you very much for the advice.
choices.feedback: Warm appreciation for the pharmacist's guidance.

choices.text: Estupendo, ¿necesito algo más o eso es todo?
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do, neh-seh-SEE-to AL-go mas o EH-so es TO-do?
choices.english: Wonderful, do I need anything else or is that all?
choices.feedback: Friendly double-check before paying.

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene el envase pequeño, cabe perfecto en la mochila. Tómelo con un vaso de agua.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh el en-VAH-seh peh-KEH-nyo, KAH-beh pehr-FEK-to en lah mo-CHEE-lah. TO-meh-lo kon oon VAH-so deh AH-gwah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Here is the small pack, it fits right in a backpack. Take it with a glass of water.

choices.text: Genial, gracias. ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta?
choices.phonetic: Heh-NYAL, GRAH-syas. PWEH-do pah-GAR kon tar-HEH-tah?
choices.english: Great, thanks. Can I pay by card?
choices.feedback: Clear and smooth checkout.

choices.text: Muchas gracias, muy amable por explicarlo.
choices.phonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas, mwee ah-MAH-bleh por eks-plee-KAR-lo.
choices.english: Thank you very much, very kind of you to explain.
choices.feedback: Gracious and natural Spanish courtesy.

nodes.npcText: Listo, aquí tiene su bolsa y el ticket. ¡Cuídese mucho y buen viaje!
nodes.npcPhonetic: LEES-to, ah-KEE TYEH-neh soo BOL-sah ee el TEE-ket. KWEE-deh-seh MOO-cho ee bwen VYAH-heh!
nodes.npcEnglish: All set, here is your bag and receipt. Take good care and have a great trip!

title: Alhambra Audio Guide Desk
setting: A busy entrance pavilion outside Granada's Alhambra palace.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenos días! Su entrada a los Palacios Nazaríes es a las once. ¿Desea recoger una audioguía?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as! Soo en-TRAH-dah ah los pah-LAH-syos nah-sah-REE-es es ah las ON-seh. Deh-SEH-ah reh-ko-HEHR OO-nah ah-oo-dyo-GEE-ah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning! Your Nasrid Palaces entry is at eleven. Would you like to pick up an audio guide?

choices.text: Sí, una en español para practicar, por favor.
choices.phonetic: See, OO-nah en es-pah-NYOL PAH-rah prak-tee-KAR, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: Yes, one in Spanish to practice, please.
choices.feedback: Wonderful initiative! Guides always appreciate visitors practicing Spanish.

choices.text: ¿Cuánto tiempo conviene reservar para los jardines del Generalife?
choices.phonetic: KWAN-to TYEM-po kon-VYEH-neh reh-sehr-VAR PAH-rah los har-DEE-nes del heh-neh-rah-LEE-feh?
choices.english: How much time should I set aside for the Generalife gardens?
choices.feedback: Smart planning question with natural intermediate phrasing.

nodes.npcText: ¡Qué buena idea! Además tiene versión con ritmo pausado y explicaciones de arquitectura.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Keh BWEH-nah ee-DEH-ah! Ah-deh-MAS TYEH-neh vehr-SYON kon REET-mo pah-oo-SAH-do ee eks-plee-kah-SYO-nes deh ar-kee-tek-TOO-rah.
nodes.npcEnglish: What a great idea! It even has a slower-paced track and architecture notes.

choices.text: Perfecto, me quedo con la de ritmo pausado. ¿Dónde la devuelvo?
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, meh KEH-do kon lah deh REET-mo pah-oo-SAH-do. DOHN-deh lah deh-VWEL-vo?
choices.english: Perfect, I'll take the slower-paced one. Where do I return it?
choices.feedback: Clear follow-up using 'devolver' (to return an item).

choices.text: Estupendo. ¿Debo estar en la cola de los palacios mucho antes?
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do. DEH-bo es-TAR en lah KO-lah deh los pah-LAH-syos MOO-cho AN-tes?
choices.english: Wonderful. Should I line up for the palaces much earlier?
choices.feedback: Essential practical question—Alhambra entry times are strict!

nodes.npcText: Calcule al menos una hora y media para pasear sin prisas por los patios y fuentes.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Kal-KOO-leh al MEH-nos OO-nah O-rah ee MEH-dyah PAH-rah pah-seh-AR seen PREE-sas por los PAH-tyos ee FWEN-tes.
nodes.npcEnglish: Allow at least an hour and a half to stroll unhurriedly through the courtyards and fountains.

choices.text: Entonces tomo la audioguía y empiezo por los jardines.
choices.phonetic: En-TON-ses TO-mo lah ah-oo-dyo-GEE-ah ee em-PYEH-so por los har-DEE-nes.
choices.english: Then I'll take the audio guide and start with the gardens.
choices.feedback: Great logical connector ('Entonces') and clear plan.

choices.text: ¿Me da tiempo a ver la Alcazaba antes de las once?
choices.phonetic: Meh dah TYEM-po ah vehr lah al-kah-SAH-bah AN-tes deh las ON-seh?
choices.english: Do I have time to see the Alcazaba before eleven?
choices.feedback: Super idiomatic! '¿Me da tiempo a...?' is native everyday Spanish.

nodes.npcText: La devuelve en la caseta de la salida principal. Solo hay que pulsar el número de cada sala.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Lah deh-VWEL-veh en lah kah-SEH-tah deh lah sah-LEE-dah preen-see-PAL. SO-lo eye keh pool-SAR el NOO-meh-ro deh KAH-dah SAH-lah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Return it at the booth by the main exit. Just press the number for each room.

choices.text: Clarísimo, muchas gracias por las indicaciones.
choices.phonetic: Klah-REE-see-mo, MOO-chas GRAH-syas por las een-dee-kah-SYO-nes.
choices.english: Crystal clear, thank you very much for the instructions.
choices.feedback: Natural and enthusiastic! 'Clarísimo' means 'crystal clear.'

choices.text: ¿Se pueden hacer fotos sin flash dentro de los patios?
choices.phonetic: Seh PWEH-den ah-SEHR FO-tos seen flash DEN-tro deh los PAH-tyos?
choices.english: Are photos without flash allowed inside the courtyards?
choices.feedback: Respectful and useful museum etiquette question.

nodes.npcText: Sí, llegue veinte minutos antes con su pasaporte original porque son muy puntuales.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, YEH-geh VEYN-teh mee-NOO-tos AN-tes kon soo pah-sah-POR-teh o-ree-hee-NAL POR-keh son mwee poon-TWAH-les.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, arrive twenty minutes early with your original passport because they're very punctual.

choices.text: Qué bien que me lo recuerda, llevo el pasaporte encima.
choices.phonetic: Keh byen keh meh lo reh-KWEHR-dah, YEH-vo el pah-sah-POR-teh en-SEE-mah.
choices.english: Good thing you reminded me, I have my passport on me.
choices.feedback: Spot-on idiom: 'llevar encima' means 'to carry on one's person.'

choices.text: Pongo una alarma en el móvil para no despistarme.
choices.phonetic: POHN-go OO-nah ah-LAR-mah en el MO-veel PAH-rah no des-pees-TAR-meh.
choices.english: I'll set an alarm on my phone so I don't lose track of time.
choices.feedback: Very natural Spanish ('móvil', 'despistarme').

nodes.npcText: ¡Estupendo! Puede sacar fotos sin flash y disfrutar con calma. ¡Que tenga una visita inolvidable!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es-too-PEN-do! PWEH-deh sah-KAR FO-tos seen flash ee dees-froo-TAR kon KAL-mah. Keh TEN-gah OO-nah vee-SEE-tah een-ol-vee-DAH-bleh!
nodes.npcEnglish: Wonderful! You can take flash-free photos and enjoy at your own pace. Have an unforgettable visit!

title: Tapas Bar in Triana
setting: A lively Seville riverside tapas bar with chalkboard specials.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenas noches! Hoy la pizarra viene cargada: salmorejo, espinacas con garbanzos y cazón en adobo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nas NO-ches! Oy lah pee-SAH-rrah VYEH-neh kar-GAH-dah: sal-mo-REH-ho, es-pee-NAH-kas kon gar-BAN-sos ee kah-SON en ah-DO-bo.
nodes.npcEnglish: Good evening! Today's chalkboard is packed: salmorejo, spinach with chickpeas, and marinated dogfish.

choices.text: ¿Qué nos aconseja si queremos compartir tres tapas?
choices.phonetic: Keh nos ah-kon-SEH-hah see keh-REH-mos kom-par-TEER tres TAH-pas?
choices.english: What do you advise if we want to share three tapas?
choices.feedback: Asking the bartender for a sharing combo is pure Seville style.

choices.text: Nunca he probado las espinacas con garbanzos, ¿llevan picante?
choices.phonetic: NOON-kah eh pro-BAH-do las es-pee-NAH-kas kon gar-BAN-sos, YEH-van pee-KAN-teh?
choices.english: I've never tried the spinach with chickpeas—are they spicy?
choices.feedback: Great use of present perfect ('nunca he probado') and ingredient check.

nodes.npcText: Yo pediría el salmorejo, las espinacas y unas puntillitas fritas para variar texturas.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Yo peh-dee-REE-ah el sal-mo-REH-ho, las es-pee-NAH-kas ee OO-nas poon-tee-YEE-tas FREE-tas PAH-rah vah-RYAR teks-TOO-ras.
nodes.npcEnglish: I'd order the salmorejo, the spinach, and some crispy baby squid to mix up textures.

choices.text: Nos fiamos de usted, pónganos esas tres, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Nos FYAH-mos deh oos-TED, POHN-gah-nos EH-sas tres, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: We trust your judgment, bring us those three, please.
choices.feedback: Fantastic idiom! 'Nos fiamos de...' warms every Spanish waiter's heart.

choices.text: Cambiemos el pescado por queso curado, si puede ser.
choices.phonetic: Kam-BYEH-mos el pes-KAH-do por KEH-so koo-RAH-do, see PWEH-deh sehr.
choices.english: Let's swap the fish for aged cheese, if possible.
choices.feedback: Polite customization using 'si puede ser'.

nodes.npcText: No pican nada; llevan comino, ajo suave y un toque de pimentón dulce. Son un clásico de Sevilla.
nodes.npcPhonetic: No PEE-kan NAH-dah; YEH-van ko-MEE-no, AH-ho SWAH-veh ee oon TO-keh deh pee-men-TON DOOL-seh. Son oon KLAH-see-ko deh seh-VEE-yah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Not spicy at all; they have cumin, mild garlic, and a hint of sweet paprika. A Seville classic.

choices.text: ¡Convencido! Póngame las espinacas y un salmorejo.
choices.phonetic: Kon-ven-SEE-do! POHN-gah-meh las es-pee-NAH-kas ee oon sal-mo-REH-ho.
choices.english: Sold! Bring me the spinach and a salmorejo.
choices.feedback: Lively and authentic ('¡Convencido!').

choices.text: Qué buena explicación. Pido las espinacas y algo frío.
choices.phonetic: Keh BWEH-nah eks-plee-kah-SYON. PEE-do las es-pee-NAH-kas ee AL-go FREE-o.
choices.english: Great explanation. I'll order the spinach and something chilled.
choices.feedback: Friendly and clear ordering style.

nodes.npcText: ¡Marchando! ¿Les traigo todo junto o prefieren que vaya saliendo poco a poco?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Mar-CHAN-do! Les TRY-go TO-do HOON-to o preh-FYEH-ren keh VAH-yah sah-LYEN-do PO-ko ah PO-ko?
nodes.npcEnglish: Coming up! Should I bring everything together or let it come out bit by bit?

choices.text: Poco a poco está genial, así todo llega caliente.
choices.phonetic: PO-ko ah PO-ko es-TAH heh-NYAL, ah-SEE TO-do YEH-gah kah-LYEN-teh.
choices.english: Bit by bit is great, so everything arrives hot.
choices.feedback: True tapas etiquette—sharing dishes as they come fresh from the kitchen.

choices.text: Si puede ser todo a la vez, tenemos bastante hambre.
choices.phonetic: See PWEH-deh sehr TO-do ah lah ves, teh-NEH-mos bas-TAN-teh AM-breh.
choices.english: All at once if possible, we're quite hungry.
choices.feedback: Honest, natural, and polite!

nodes.npcText: Sin problema, lo adapto en cocina. ¿Y para beber les apetece tinto de verano o mosto?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Seen pro-BLEH-mah, lo ah-DAP-to en ko-SEE-nah. Ee PAH-rah beh-BEHR les ah-peh-TEH-seh TEEN-to deh veh-RAH-no o MOS-to?
nodes.npcEnglish: No problem, I'll adjust it with the kitchen. And to drink, tinto de verano or grape must?

choices.text: Un tinto de verano con limón y mucho hielo, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Oon TEEN-to deh veh-RAH-no kon lee-MON ee MOO-cho YEH-lo, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: A tinto de verano with lemon and plenty of ice, please.
choices.feedback: Classic Andalusian summer order!

choices.text: Prefiero probar el mosto sin alcohol, gracias.
choices.phonetic: Preh-FYEH-ro pro-BAR el MOS-to seen al-ko-OL, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: I'd rather try the non-alcoholic grape must, thanks.
choices.feedback: Great local choice—Andalusian 'mosto' is a regional gem.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hecho! Ahora mismo les traigo las bebidas y enseguida empiezan a salir las tapas.
nodes.npcPhonetic: EH-cho! Ah-O-rah MEES-mo les TRY-go las beh-BEE-das ee en-seh-GEE-dah em-PYEH-san ah sah-LEER las TAH-pas.
nodes.npcEnglish: Done! I'll bring your drinks right now and the tapas will start coming out shortly.

title: Flamenco Box Office
setting: An intimate historic tablao ticket counter in central Madrid.

nodes.npcText: Buenas tardes. Esta noche tenemos dos pases de flamenco, a las siete y media y a las diez.
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nas TAR-des. ES-tah NO-cheh teh-NEH-mos dos PAH-ses deh flah-MEN-ko, ah las SYEH-teh ee MEH-dyah ee ah las DYES.
nodes.npcEnglish: Good afternoon. Tonight we have two flamenco shows, at 7:30 and 10:00.

choices.text: ¿Quedan entradas con buena visibilidad para el pase de las siete y media?
choices.phonetic: KEH-dan en-TRAH-das kon BWEH-nah vee-see-bee-lee-DAD PAH-rah el PAH-seh deh las SYEH-teh ee MEH-dyah?
choices.english: Are there tickets left with a good view for the 7:30 show?
choices.feedback: Excellent! '¿Quedan entradas?' is the exact way to ask about availability.

choices.text: ¿Qué diferencia hay entre la entrada general y la que incluye cena?
choices.phonetic: Keh dee-feh-REN-syah eye EN-treh lah en-TRAH-dah heh-neh-RAL ee lah keh een-KLOO-yeh SEH-nah?
choices.english: What's the difference between general admission and the dinner ticket?
choices.feedback: Smart comparison question before booking.

nodes.npcText: Nos quedan dos asientos en segunda fila, muy cerca del escenario para escuchar el zapateado.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Nos KEH-dan dos ah-SYEN-tos en seh-GOON-dah FEE-lah, mwee SEHR-kah del es-seh-NAH-ryo PAH-rah es-koo-CHAR el sah-pah-teh-AH-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: We have two seats left in the second row, very close to the stage to hear the footwork.

choices.text: ¡Qué suerte! Me quedo con esos dos asientos.
choices.phonetic: Keh SWEHR-teh! Meh KEH-do kon EH-sos dos ah-SYEN-tos.
choices.english: How lucky! I'll take those two seats.
choices.feedback: Natural excitement and decisive phrasing.

choices.text: ¿Cuánto dura el espectáculo y está incluida una consumición?
choices.phonetic: KWAN-to DOO-rah el es-pek-TAH-koo-lo ee es-TAH een-kloo-EE-dah OO-nah kon-soo-mee-SYON?
choices.english: How long is the show and is a drink included?
choices.feedback: Great vocabulary: 'consumición' means an included drink.

nodes.npcText: La general incluye una bebida y el espectáculo de una hora; la cena empieza cuarenta minutos antes.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Lah heh-neh-RAL een-KLOO-yeh OO-nah beh-BEE-dah ee el es-pek-TAH-koo-lo deh OO-nah O-rah; lah SEH-nah em-PYEH-sah kwah-REN-tah mee-NOO-tos AN-tes.
nodes.npcEnglish: General admission includes one drink and the one-hour show; dinner starts forty minutes earlier.

choices.text: Prefiero solo espectáculo con bebida para cenar luego por el barrio.
choices.phonetic: Preh-FYEH-ro SO-lo es-pek-TAH-koo-lo kon beh-BEE-dah PAH-rah seh-NAR LWEH-go por el BAH-rryo.
choices.english: I'd rather do just the show with a drink so I can have dinner in the neighborhood afterward.
choices.feedback: Very natural phrasing and great local evening plan!

choices.text: Suena muy cómodo con cena. ¿Para el pase de las diez hay sitio?
choices.phonetic: SWEH-nah mwee KO-mo-do kon SEH-nah. PAH-rah el PAH-seh deh las DYES eye SEE-tyo?
choices.english: Dinner sounds very convenient. Is there room for the ten o'clock show?
choices.feedback: Clear question combining preference and availability.

nodes.npcText: Estupendo. Le recomiendo llegar quince minutos antes para acomodarse sin prisas.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es-too-PEN-do. Leh reh-ko-MYEN-do yeh-GAR KEEN-seh mee-NOO-tos AN-tes PAH-rah ah-ko-mo-DAR-seh seen PREE-sas.
nodes.npcEnglish: Wonderful. I recommend arriving fifteen minutes early to get settled without rushing.

choices.text: Allí estaremos puntuales. ¿Se pueden hacer fotos al final?
choices.phonetic: Ah-YEE es-tah-REH-mos poon-TWAH-les. Seh PWEH-den ah-SEHR FO-tos al fee-NAL?
choices.english: We'll be there on time. Can we take photos at the end?
choices.feedback: Thoughtful etiquette check!

choices.text: Perfecto, pago con tarjeta ahora mismo.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, PAH-go kon tar-HEH-tah ah-O-rah MEES-mo.
choices.english: Perfect, I'll pay by card right now.
choices.feedback: Crisp and smooth closing.

nodes.npcText: Sí, dura una hora intensa con guitarra, cante y baile, y en el bis final pueden grabar un recuerdo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, DOO-rah OO-nah O-rah een-TEN-sah kon gee-TAH-rrah, KAN-teh ee BY-leh, ee en el bees fee-NAL PWEH-den grah-BAR oon reh-KWEHR-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, it lasts an intense hour with guitar, vocals, and dance, and during the final encore you may film a keepsake.

choices.text: Qué buena norma, así disfrutamos sin móviles durante el baile.
choices.phonetic: Keh BWEH-nah NOR-mah, ah-SEE dees-froo-TAH-mos seen MO-vee-les doo-RAN-teh el BY-leh.
choices.english: What a great rule, so we enjoy without phones during the dance.
choices.feedback: Expressive, natural conversational agreement.

choices.text: Estupendo, reservo dos plazas ahora mismo.
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do, reh-SEHR-vo dos PLAH-sas ah-O-rah MEES-mo.
choices.english: Wonderful, I'll reserve two spots right now.
choices.feedback: Clear and idiomatic ('plazas' = spots/seats).

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene sus entradas. ¡Prepárese para una noche llena de duende!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh soos en-TRAH-das. Preh-PAH-reh-seh PAH-rah OO-nah NO-cheh YEH-nah deh DWEN-deh!
nodes.npcEnglish: Here are your tickets. Get ready for a night full of flamenco soul!

title: Lost Luggage Counter
setting: The baggage assistance desk at Madrid-Barajas airport after a connecting flight.

nodes.npcText: Buenas tardes, siento la espera. ¿No ha salido su maleta en la cinta cinco?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nas TAR-des, SYEN-to lah es-PEH-rah. No ah sah-LEE-do soo mah-LEH-tah en lah SEEN-tah SEEN-ko?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good afternoon, sorry for the wait. Didn't your suitcase come out on carousel five?

choices.text: Así es, ya terminó la cinta y mi maleta no aparece. Aquí está mi resguardo.
choices.phonetic: Ah-SEE es, yah tehr-mee-NO lah SEEN-tah ee mee mah-LEH-tah no ah-pah-REH-seh. Ah-KEE es-TAH mee res-GWAR-do.
choices.english: That's right, the carousel stopped and my suitcase isn't here. Here is my bag tag.
choices.feedback: Calm, clear, and uses 'resguardo' (claim stub) like a pro.

choices.text: Creo que se quedó en la escala porque fue muy corta.
choices.phonetic: KREH-o keh seh keh-DO en lah es-KAH-lah POR-keh fweh mwee KOR-tah.
choices.english: I think it stayed behind at the layover because it was very short.
choices.feedback: Great use of 'escala' (layover) and past tense narration.

nodes.npcText: Déjeme escanear el código… Sí, está localizada y viene en el vuelo de esta noche.
nodes.npcPhonetic: DEH-heh-meh es-kah-neh-AR el KO-dee-go... See, es-TAH lo-kah-lee-SAH-dah ee VYEH-neh en el VWEH-lo deh ES-tah NO-cheh.
nodes.npcEnglish: Let me scan the barcode... Yes, it's been located and is arriving on tonight's flight.

choices.text: ¡Qué alivio! ¿Me la pueden enviar directamente al hotel?
choices.phonetic: Keh ah-LEE-vyo! Meh lah PWEH-den en-VYAR dee-rek-tah-MEN-teh al o-TEL?
choices.english: What a relief! Can you send it directly to my hotel?
choices.feedback: Super clear, polite, and uses double pronouns ('me la') accurately!

choices.text: ¿Me puede dar un número de expediente para seguir el envío?
choices.phonetic: Meh PWEH-deh dar oon NOO-meh-ro deh eks-peh-DYEN-teh PAH-rah seh-GEER el en-VEE-o?
choices.english: Can you give me a reference number to track the delivery?
choices.feedback: Sharp vocabulary: 'número de expediente' (case/claim number).

nodes.npcText: Tiene toda la razón, el sistema muestra que llegará a Madrid a las nueve de la noche.
nodes.npcPhonetic: TYEH-neh TO-dah lah rah-SON, el sees-TEH-mah MWES-trah keh yeh-gah-RAH ah mah-DREED ah las NWEH-veh deh lah NO-cheh.
nodes.npcEnglish: You're completely right, the system shows it will arrive in Madrid at nine tonight.

choices.text: ¿La entregan esta misma noche en mi alojamiento o mañana temprano?
choices.phonetic: Lah en-TREH-gan ES-tah MEES-mah NO-cheh en mee ah-lo-hah-MYEN-to o mah-NYAH-nah tem-PRAH-no?
choices.english: Will they deliver it to my lodging tonight or early tomorrow?
choices.feedback: Very natural phrasing ('alojamiento' covers hotels and apartments).

choices.text: ¿Incluye algún kit básico de aseo mientras espero?
choices.phonetic: Een-KLOO-yeh al-GOON keet BAH-see-ko deh ah-SEH-o MYEN-tras es-PEH-ro?
choices.english: Does it include a basic toiletries kit while I wait?
choices.feedback: Practical traveler question ('kit de aseo').

nodes.npcText: Sí, el mensajero la lleva mañana antes de las diez y le avisamos por mensaje antes de salir.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, el men-sah-HEH-ro lah YEH-vah mah-NYAH-nah AN-tes deh las DYES ee leh ah-vee-SAH-mos por men-SAH-heh AN-tes deh sah-LEER.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, the courier will deliver it tomorrow before ten and we'll text you before heading out.

choices.text: Perfecto, dejo la dirección del hotel y mi número de teléfono.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, DEH-ho lah dee-rek-SYON del o-TEL ee mee NOO-meh-ro deh teh-LEH-fo-no.
choices.english: Perfect, I'll leave the hotel address and my phone number.
choices.feedback: Clear, organized, and cooperative.

choices.text: ¿La pueden dejar en recepción si ya salí a desayunar?
choices.phonetic: Lah PWEH-den deh-HAR en reh-sep-SYON see yah sah-LEE ah deh-sah-yoo-NAR?
choices.english: Can they leave it at reception if I've already gone out for breakfast?
choices.feedback: Very practical detail phrased naturally in Spanish.

nodes.npcText: Por supuesto, aquí tiene el código de seguimiento y una bolsita de cortesía con cepillo y camiseta.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Por soo-PWES-to, ah-KEE TYEH-neh el KO-dee-go deh seh-gee-MYEN-to ee OO-nah bol-SEE-tah deh kor-teh-SEE-ah kon seh-PEE-yo ee kah-mee-SEH-tah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Of course, here is your tracking code and a courtesy pouch with a toothbrush and t-shirt.

choices.text: Muchísimas gracias, me quita un gran peso de encima.
choices.phonetic: Moo-CHEE-see-mas GRAH-syas, meh KEE-tah oon gran PEH-so deh en-SEE-mah.
choices.english: Thank you so much, that's a huge weight off my shoulders.
choices.feedback: Wonderful native idiom: 'quitar un peso de encima'!

choices.text: Gracias por gestionarlo tan rápido, muy amable.
choices.phonetic: GRAH-syas por hes-tyo-NAR-lo tan RAH-pee-do, mwee ah-MAH-bleh.
choices.english: Thanks for handling it so quickly, very kind of you.
choices.feedback: Polite and appreciative ('gestionar' = to handle/process).

nodes.npcText: De nada, la dejaremos en recepción sin problema. ¡Disfrute de Madrid pese al contratiempo!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Deh NAH-dah, lah deh-hah-REH-mos en reh-sep-SYON seen pro-BLEH-mah. Dees-FROO-teh deh mah-DREED PEH-seh al kon-trah-TYEM-po!
nodes.npcEnglish: You're welcome, we'll leave it at reception with no problem. Enjoy Madrid despite the hiccup!

title: El Rastro Flea Market
setting: A bustling Sunday antique stall along Madrid's famous El Rastro street market.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenos días! Eche un vistazo sin compromiso. Esa lámpara de latón es de los años sesenta.
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as! EH-cheh oon vees-TAH-so seen kom-pro-MEE-so. EH-sah LAM-pah-rah deh lah-TON es deh los AH-nyos seh-SEN-tah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning! Take a look with no obligation. That brass lamp is from the sixties.

choices.text: Tiene muchísimo encanto. ¿Funciona bien el cableado o es solo decorativa?
choices.phonetic: TYEH-neh moo-CHEE-see-mo en-KAN-to. Foon-SYO-nah byen el kah-bleh-AH-do o es SO-lo deh-ko-rah-TEE-vah?
choices.english: It has so much charm. Does the wiring work well or is it just decorative?
choices.feedback: Smart buyer question with authentic vocabulary ('cableado').

choices.text: También me gustan estos carteles antiguos. ¿Cuánto pide por uno?
choices.phonetic: Tam-BYEN meh GOOS-tan ES-tos kar-TEH-les an-TEE-gwos. KWAN-to PEE-deh por OO-no?
choices.english: I also like these vintage posters. How much are you asking for one?
choices.feedback: Great flea-market phrasing: '¿Cuánto pide por...?'

nodes.npcText: La restauré la semana pasada con enchufe nuevo. Pido cuarenta y cinco euros por ella.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Lah res-tah-oo-REH lah seh-MAH-nah pah-SAH-dah kon en-CHOO-feh NWEH-vo. PEE-do kwah-REN-tah ee SEEN-ko EH-oo-ros por EH-yah.
nodes.npcEnglish: I restored it last week with a new plug. I'm asking forty-five euros for it.

choices.text: Es preciosa, ¿me la podría dejar en treinta y cinco si pago en efectivo?
choices.phonetic: Es preh-SYO-sah, meh lah po-DREE-ah deh-HAR en TREYN-tah ee SEEN-ko see PAH-go en eh-fek-TEE-vo?
choices.english: It's gorgeous—could you let me have it for thirty-five if I pay cash?
choices.feedback: Respectful, classic bargaining using the conditional ('podría')!

choices.text: Voy a dar una vuelta por el mercado y lo pienso, gracias.
choices.phonetic: Voy ah dar OO-nah VWEL-tah por el mehr-KAH-do ee lo PYEN-so, GRAH-syas.
choices.english: I'm going to walk around the market and think about it, thanks.
choices.feedback: Polite way to browse without pressure ('dar una vuelta').

nodes.npcText: Los carteles de cine clásico están a veinte euros, y cada uno viene en su tubo protector.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Los kar-TEH-les deh SEE-neh KLAH-see-ko es-TAN ah VEYN-teh EH-oo-ros, ee KAH-dah OO-no VYEH-neh en soo TOO-bo pro-tek-TOR.
nodes.npcEnglish: The classic film posters are twenty euros, and each comes in a protective tube.

choices.text: Si me llevo dos carteles, ¿me hace un pequeño descuento?
choices.phonetic: See meh YEH-vo dos kar-TEH-les, meh AH-seh oon peh-KEH-nyo des-KWEN-to?
choices.english: If I take two posters, could you give me a small discount?
choices.feedback: Friendly bundle negotiation—very natural at El Rastro.

choices.text: ¿Tiene alguno de películas españolas de los setenta?
choices.phonetic: TYEH-neh al-GOO-no deh peh-LEE-koo-las es-pah-NYO-las deh los seh-TEN-tah?
choices.english: Do you have any from seventies Spanish films?
choices.feedback: Engaging collector question!

nodes.npcText: Venga, por ser tan amable quedamos a mitad de camino: treinta y ocho euros y todo listo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: VEN-gah, por sehr tan ah-MAH-bleh keh-DAH-mos ah mee-TAD deh kah-MEE-no: TREYN-tah ee O-cho EH-oo-ros ee TO-do LEES-to.
nodes.npcEnglish: Come on, since you're so polite let's meet halfway: thirty-eight euros and it's yours.

choices.text: Me parece muy justo, trato hecho.
choices.phonetic: Meh pah-REH-seh mwee HOOS-to, TRAH-to EH-cho.
choices.english: That seems very fair, deal.
choices.feedback: Gracious close to a friendly negotiation!

choices.text: Estupendo, aquí tiene el dinero exacto.
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do, ah-KEE TYEH-neh el dee-NEH-ro ek-SAK-to.
choices.english: Wonderful, here is the exact change.
choices.feedback: Vendors at street markets always appreciate exact cash.

nodes.npcText: Tengo esta joya original guardada atrás. Si vuelve antes de las dos, se la reservo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: TEN-go ES-tah HO-yah o-ree-hee-NAL gwar-DAH-dah ah-TRAS. See VWEL-veh AN-tes deh las dos, seh lah reh-SEHR-vo.
nodes.npcEnglish: I have this original gem tucked in the back. If you come back before two, I'll hold it for you.

choices.text: Me la llevo ya mismo antes de que desaparezca.
choices.phonetic: Meh lah YEH-vo yah MEES-mo AN-tes deh keh deh-sah-pah-RES-kah.
choices.english: I'll take it right now before it disappears.
choices.feedback: Playful and natural—awesome use of the subjunctive ('desaparezca')!

choices.text: Gracias por enseñármela, vuelvo en media hora seguro.
choices.phonetic: GRAH-syas por en-seh-NYAR-meh-lah, VWEL-vo en MEH-dyah O-rah seh-GOO-ro.
choices.english: Thanks for showing it to me, I'll definitely be back in half an hour.
choices.feedback: Polite and clear commitment.

nodes.npcText: ¡Estupendo! Se lleva una pieza con historia. ¡Que disfrute el domingo en El Rastro!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es-too-PEN-do! Seh YEH-vah OO-nah PYEH-sah kon ees-TO-ryah. Keh dees-FROO-teh el do-MEEN-go en el RAS-tro!
nodes.npcEnglish: Wonderful! You're taking home a piece with history. Enjoy your Sunday at El Rastro!

title: Bicycle Tour Along the Turia
setting: A cheerful bike rental shop near Valencia's green Turia riverbed park.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hola! Hoy hace una brisa perfecta para recorrer el Jardín del Turia. ¿Busca bici urbana o eléctrica?
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-lah! Oy AH-seh OO-nah BREE-sah pehr-FEK-tah PAH-rah reh-ko-RREHR el har-DEEN del TOO-ryah. BOOS-kah BEE-see oor-BAH-nah o eh-LEK-tree-kah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hello! Today has a perfect breeze for riding through Turia Park. Looking for a city bike or e-bike?

choices.text: Una bici urbana con cesta, por favor. El parque es bastante llano, ¿verdad?
choices.phonetic: OO-nah BEE-see oor-BAH-nah kon SES-tah, por fah-VOR. El PAR-keh es bas-TAN-teh YAH-no, vehr-DAD?
choices.english: A city bike with a basket, please. The park is fairly flat, right?
choices.feedback: Great cycling vocabulary ('cesta', 'llano') and friendly tag question!

choices.text: Prefiero una eléctrica para llegar hasta la Ciudad de las Artes sin cansarme.
choices.phonetic: Preh-FYEH-ro OO-nah eh-LEK-tree-kah PAH-rah yeh-GAR AH-stah lah syoo-DAD deh las AR-tes seen kan-SAR-meh.
choices.english: I'd prefer an e-bike so I can reach the City of Arts without getting tired.
choices.feedback: Very natural phrasing with 'sin + infinitive'.

nodes.npcText: Totalmente llano y lleno de carriles bici. Vamos a ajustar la altura del sillín.
nodes.npcPhonetic: To-tal-MEN-teh YAH-no ee YEH-no deh kah-RREE-les BEE-see. VAH-mos ah ah-hoos-TAR lah al-TOO-rah del see-YEEN.
nodes.npcEnglish: Completely flat and full of bike lanes. Let's adjust the saddle height.

choices.text: Un poquito más alto, por favor. Así pedaleo más cómodo.
choices.phonetic: Oon po-KEE-to mas AL-to, por fah-VOR. Ah-SEE peh-dah-LEH-o mas KO-mo-do.
choices.english: A tiny bit higher, please. That way I pedal more comfortably.
choices.feedback: Spot-on! Diminutive 'poquito' softens requests naturally.

choices.text: Así está perfecto. ¿Incluye candado y casco el alquiler?
choices.phonetic: Ah-SEE es-TAH pehr-FEK-to. Een-KLOO-yeh kan-DAH-do ee KAS-ko el al-kee-LEHR?
choices.english: That's perfect. Does the rental include a lock and helmet?
choices.feedback: Essential practical check ('candado', 'casco').

nodes.npcText: Gran idea, con la asistencia eléctrica llegas en veinte minutos disfrutando del paisaje.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Gran ee-DEH-ah, kon lah ah-sees-TEN-syah eh-LEK-tree-kah YEH-gas en VEYN-teh mee-NOO-tos dees-froo-TAN-do del py-SAH-heh.
nodes.npcEnglish: Great idea, with electric assist you get there in twenty minutes enjoying the scenery.

choices.text: ¿Cuánta batería tiene y cómo se cambia el nivel de asistencia?
choices.phonetic: KWAN-tah bah-teh-REE-ah TYEH-neh ee KO-mo seh KAM-byah el nee-VEL deh ah-sees-TEN-syah?
choices.english: How much battery does it have and how do you change the assist level?
choices.feedback: Sharp technical question in smooth everyday Spanish.

choices.text: ¿Hay zonas donde se pueda aparcar la bici con candado?
choices.phonetic: Eye SO-nas DOHN-deh seh PWEH-dah ah-par-KAR lah BEE-see kon kan-DAH-do?
choices.english: Are there areas where you can lock up the bike?
choices.feedback: Great use of 'donde se pueda' for polite inquiry.

nodes.npcText: Tiene carga completa y se ajusta con el botón del manillar. También le doy un mapa del parque.
nodes.npcPhonetic: TYEH-neh KAR-gah kom-PLEH-tah ee seh ah-HOOS-tah kon el bo-TON del mah-nee-YAR. Tam-BYEN leh doy oon MAH-pah del PAR-keh.
nodes.npcEnglish: It has a full charge and adjusts with the handlebar button. I'll also give you a park map.

choices.text: Genial, ¿hasta qué hora tengo que devolverla?
