choices.phonetic: Heh-NYAL, AH-stah keh OH-rah TEN-go keh deh-vol-VEHR-lah?
choices.english: Great, by what time do I need to return it?
choices.feedback: Crucial detail phrased cleanly!

choices.text: Muchas gracias, me viene genial el mapa para no perderme.
choices.phonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas, meh VYEH-neh heh-NYAL el MAH-pah PAH-rah no pehr-DEHR-meh.
choices.english: Thank you very much, the map will come in really handy so I don't get lost.
choices.feedback: Great native expression: 'me viene genial' (comes in really handy).

nodes.npcText: Sí, el candado y el casco van incluidos, y junto a cada puente hay aparcabicis seguros.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, el kan-DAH-do ee el KAS-ko van een-kloo-EE-dos, ee HOON-to ah KAH-dah PWEN-teh eye ah-par-kah-BEE-sees seh-GOO-ros.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, lock and helmet are included, and next to every bridge there are safe bike racks.

choices.text: Qué comodidad. Alquilo para cuatro horas, por favor.
choices.phonetic: Keh ko-mo-dee-DAD. Al-KEE-lo PAH-rah KWAH-tro O-ras, por fah-VOR.
choices.english: How convenient. I'll rent it for four hours, please.
choices.feedback: Clear rental duration and natural tone.

choices.text: Perfecto, me pongo el casco y salgo ahora mismo.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, meh POHN-go el KAS-ko ee SAL-go ah-O-rah MEES-mo.
choices.english: Perfect, I'll put on the helmet and head out right away.
choices.feedback: Great reflexive verb usage ('ponerse el casco').

nodes.npcText: Hasta las siete de la tarde estamos abiertos. ¡Buen paseo y disfrute de Valencia sobre ruedas!
nodes.npcPhonetic: AH-stah las SYEH-teh deh lah TAR-deh es-TAH-mos ah-BYEHR-tos. Bwen pah-SEH-o ee dees-FROO-teh deh vah-LEN-syah SO-breh RWEH-das!
nodes.npcEnglish: We're open until seven in the evening. Enjoy your ride around Valencia on two wheels!

title: Cooking Paella in Valencia
setting: A sunlit culinary studio where a local chef leads an afternoon paella workshop.

nodes.npcText: ¡Bienvenidos al taller! Hoy cocinaremos paella valenciana tradicional. ¿Ya han hecho arroz antes?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Byen-veh-NEE-dos al tah-YEHR! Oy ko-see-nah-REH-mos pah-EH-yah vah-len-SYAH-nah trah-dee-syo-NAL. Yah an EH-cho ah-RROS AN-tes?
nodes.npcEnglish: Welcome to the workshop! Today we'll cook traditional Valencian paella. Have you made rice before?

choices.text: Solo arroz hervido en casa, ¡tengo muchas ganas de aprender el secreto del socarrat!
choices.phonetic: SO-lo ah-RROS ehr-VEE-do en KAH-sah, TEN-go MOO-chas GAH-nas deh ah-pren-DEHR el seh-KREH-to del so-kah-RRAT!
choices.english: Only boiled rice at home—I'm really excited to learn the secret of socarrat!
choices.feedback: Enthusiastic and authentic! Mentioning 'socarrat' (crispy bottom crust) impresses any Valencian chef.

choices.text: Una vez lo intenté, pero me quedó un poco pasado.
choices.phonetic: OO-nah ves lo een-ten-TEH, PEH-ro meh keh-DO oon PO-ko pah-SAH-do.
choices.english: I tried once, but it turned out a little overcooked.
choices.feedback: Spot-on culinary Spanish! 'Quedarse pasado' means overcooked.

nodes.npcText: ¡El socarrat es puro arte! El truco está en el sofrito lento y en no remover el arroz al final.
nodes.npcPhonetic: El so-kah-RRAT es POO-ro AR-teh! El TROO-ko es-TAH en el so-FREE-to LEN-to ee en no reh-mo-VEHR el ah-RROS al fee-NAL.
nodes.npcEnglish: Socarrat is pure art! The trick is a slow sofrito and not stirring the rice at the end.

choices.text: ¿Cuándo añadimos el azafrán para que suelte todo su aroma?
choices.phonetic: KWAN-do ah-nyah-DEE-mos el ah-sah-FRAN PAH-rah keh SWEL-teh TO-do soo ah-RO-mah?
choices.english: When do we add the saffron so it releases all its aroma?
choices.feedback: Fantastic intermediate structure with 'para que + subjunctive'!

choices.text: ¿Qué variedad de arroz funciona mejor para absorber el caldo?
choices.phonetic: Keh vah-ryeh-DAD deh ah-RROS foon-SYO-nah meh-HOR PAH-rah ab-sor-BEHR el KAL-do?
choices.english: Which rice variety works best for absorbing the broth?
choices.feedback: Insightful culinary question.

nodes.npcText: Nos ha pasado a todos. Lo clave es medir bien el caldo y respetar los dieciocho minutos exactos.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Nos ah pah-SAH-do ah TO-dos. Lo KLAH-veh es meh-DEER byen el KAL-do ee res-peh-TAR los dyeh-see-O-cho mee-NOO-tos ek-SAK-tos.
nodes.npcEnglish: It's happened to all of us. The key is measuring the broth well and respecting the exact eighteen minutes.

choices.text: Apuntado. ¿Fuego fuerte al principio y luego más bajo?
choices.phonetic: Ah-poon-TAH-do. FWEH-go FWEHR-teh al preen-SEE-pyo ee LWEH-go mas BAH-ho?
choices.english: Noted. High heat at first and then lower?
choices.feedback: Concise and active—'Apuntado' means 'Got it / noted!'

choices.text: ¿Y hay que dejar reposar la paella antes de servirla?
choices.phonetic: Ee eye keh deh-HAR reh-po-SAR lah pah-EH-yah AN-tes deh sehr-VEER-lah?
choices.english: And should we let the paella rest before serving it?
choices.feedback: Great culinary verb ('dejar reposar').

nodes.npcText: Exacto: diez minutos a fuego vivo y ocho a fuego suave, con el azafrán recién tostado en el caldo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ek-SAK-to: dyes mee-NOO-tos ah FWEH-go VEE-vo ee O-cho ah FWEH-go SWAH-veh, kon el ah-sah-FRAN reh-SYEN tos-TAH-do en el KAL-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: Exactly: ten minutes on high heat and eight on gentle heat, with freshly toasted saffron in the broth.

choices.text: ¡Huele increíble! ¿Puedo ayudar a cortar las judías verdes?
choices.phonetic: WEH-leh een-kreh-EE-bleh! PWEH-do ah-yoo-DAR ah kor-TAR las hoo-DEE-as VEHR-des?
choices.english: It smells incredible! Can I help chop the green beans?
choices.feedback: Hands-on, lively, and natural!

choices.text: Me llevo la receta escrita para repetirla con amigos.
choices.phonetic: Meh YEH-vo lah reh-SEH-tah es-KREE-tah PAH-rah reh-peh-TEER-lah kon ah-MEE-gos.
choices.english: I'll take the written recipe home to recreate it with friends.
choices.feedback: Warm and enthusiastic closing.

nodes.npcText: Sí, el arroz bomba aguanta firme y cinco minutos de reposo hacen que el sabor se redondee.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, el ah-RROS BOM-bah ah-GWAN-tah FEER-meh ee SEEN-ko mee-NOO-tos deh reh-PO-so AH-sen keh el sah-BOR seh reh-don-DEH-eh.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, bomba rice stays firm and five minutes of resting rounds out the flavor.

choices.text: ¡Qué ganas de probar el resultado con cuchara de madera!
choices.phonetic: Keh GAH-nas deh pro-BAR el reh-sool-TAH-do kon koo-CHAH-rah deh mah-DEH-rah!
choices.english: I can't wait to taste the result with a wooden spoon!
choices.feedback: Authentic cultural touch—eating paella with a wooden spoon!

choices.text: Gracias chef, ya entiendo por qué sale tan rica aquí.
choices.phonetic: GRAH-syas chef, yah en-TYEN-do por keh SAH-leh tan REE-kah ah-KEE.
choices.english: Thanks chef, now I understand why it turns out so delicious here.
choices.feedback: Warm and natural appreciation.

nodes.npcText: ¡Manos a la obra entonces! En una hora estaremos brindando alrededor de nuestra paella.
nodes.npcPhonetic: MAH-nos ah lah O-brah en-TON-ses! En OO-nah O-rah es-tah-REH-mos breen-DAN-do al-reh-deh-DOR deh NWES-trah pah-EH-yah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Let's get cooking then! In an hour we'll be toasting around our paella.

title: Clinic Appointment Check-In
setting: A calm neighborhood medical clinic reception desk in Málaga.

nodes.npcText: Buenos días. ¿Viene con cita previa o necesita una consulta de urgencia?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as. VYEH-neh kon SEE-tah PREH-vyah o neh-seh-SEE-tah OO-nah kon-SOOL-tah deh oor-HEN-syah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning. Do you have an appointment or do you need an urgent visit?

choices.text: No tengo cita, pero llevo dos días con dolor de oído y algo de fiebre.
choices.phonetic: No TEN-go SEE-tah, PEH-ro YEH-vo dos DEE-as kon do-LOR deh o-EE-do ee AL-go deh FYEH-breh.
choices.english: I don't have an appointment, but I've had an earache and a slight fever for two days.
choices.feedback: Super natural! 'Llevar + time + con' is the ideal way to state symptom duration.

choices.text: Tengo seguro de viaje y me gustaría ver a un médico general hoy.
choices.phonetic: TEN-go seh-GOO-ro deh VYAH-heh ee meh goos-tah-REE-ah vehr ah oon MEH-dee-ko heh-neh-RAL oy.
choices.english: I have travel insurance and would like to see a general practitioner today.
choices.feedback: Clear and practical—lets reception check coverage right away.

nodes.npcText: Entiendo, podemos atenderle hoy mismo. ¿Tiene tarjeta sanitaria o seguro de viaje?
nodes.npcPhonetic: En-TYEN-do, po-DEH-mos ah-ten-DEHR-leh oy MEES-mo. TYEH-neh tar-HEH-tah sah-nee-TAH-ryah o seh-GOO-ro deh VYAH-heh?
nodes.npcEnglish: I understand, we can see you today. Do you have a health card or travel insurance?

choices.text: Tengo seguro de viaje. Aquí está la póliza y mi pasaporte.
choices.phonetic: TEN-go seh-GOO-ro deh VYAH-heh. Ah-KEE es-TAH lah PO-lee-sah ee mee pah-sah-POR-teh.
choices.english: I have travel insurance. Here is the policy and my passport.
choices.feedback: Accurate medical-admin vocabulary ('póliza').

choices.text: Prefiero pagar la consulta privada si así me atienden antes.
choices.phonetic: Preh-FYEH-ro pah-GAR lah kon-SOOL-tah pree-VAH-dah see ah-SEE meh ah-TYEN-den AN-tes.
choices.english: I'd rather pay for a private visit if that gets me seen sooner.
choices.feedback: Clear and polite practical option.

nodes.npcText: Sin problema, trabajamos con la mayoría de aseguradoras. ¿Cuáles son sus síntomas principales?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Seen pro-BLEH-mah, trah-bah-HAH-mos kon lah mah-yo-REE-ah deh ah-seh-goo-rah-DO-ras. KWAH-les son soos SEEN-to-mas preen-see-PAH-les?
nodes.npcEnglish: No problem, we work with most insurers. What are your main symptoms?

choices.text: Me duele mucho la garganta al tragar y estoy bastante cansado.
choices.phonetic: Meh DWEH-leh MOO-cho lah gar-GAN-tah al trah-GAR ee es-TOY bas-TAN-teh kan-SAH-do.
choices.english: My throat hurts a lot when swallowing and I'm quite tired.
choices.feedback: Very clear symptom phrasing ('me duele ... al tragar').

choices.text: Tuve una torcedura leve en el tobillo caminando ayer.
choices.phonetic: TOO-veh OO-nah tor-seh-DOO-rah LEH-veh en el to-BEE-yo kah-mee-NAN-do ah-YEHR.
choices.english: I got a mild ankle sprain while walking yesterday.
choices.feedback: Great vocabulary: 'torcedura leve' (mild sprain).

nodes.npcText: Ya quedó registrado. La doctora Morales le llamará en unos quince minutos en la sala dos.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Yah keh-DO reh-hees-TRAH-do. Lah dok-TO-rah mo-RAH-les leh yah-mah-RAH en OO-nos KEEN-seh mee-NOO-tos en lah SAH-lah dos.
nodes.npcEnglish: You're all checked in. Dr. Morales will call you in about fifteen minutes in room two.

choices.text: ¿Me pueden dar un informe médico para el seguro al terminar?
choices.phonetic: Meh PWEH-den dar oon een-FOR-meh MEH-dee-ko PAH-rah el seh-GOO-ro al tehr-mee-NAR?
choices.english: Could you give me a medical report for my insurance afterward?
choices.feedback: Very smart traveler question ('informe médico').

choices.text: Muchas gracias, espero sentado en la sala de espera.
choices.phonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas, es-PEH-ro sen-TAH-do en lah SAH-lah deh es-PEH-rah.
choices.english: Thank you very much, I'll wait seated in the waiting room.
choices.feedback: Polite and calm.

nodes.npcText: Perfecto, el doctor le revisará enseguida y le emitirá factura detallada para el reembolso.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, el dok-TOR leh reh-vee-sah-RAH en-seh-GEE-dah ee leh eh-mee-tee-RAH fak-TOO-rah deh-tah-YAH-dah PAH-rah el reh-em-BOL-so.
nodes.npcEnglish: Perfect, the doctor will examine you shortly and issue an itemized receipt for reimbursement.

choices.text: Qué tranquilidad, mil gracias por atenderme tan rápido.
choices.phonetic: Keh tran-kee-lee-DAD, meel GRAH-syas por ah-ten-DEHR-meh tan RAH-pee-do.
choices.english: What peace of mind, a thousand thanks for seeing me so quickly.
choices.feedback: Warm, grateful, and genuinely idiomatic.

choices.text: ¿Hay una farmacia cerca por si me receta algún medicamento?
choices.phonetic: Eye OO-nah far-MAH-syah SEHR-kah por see meh reh-SEH-tah al-GOON meh-dee-kah-MEN-to?
choices.english: Is there a pharmacy nearby in case they prescribe medicine?
choices.feedback: Awesome phrasing with 'por si' (in case)!

nodes.npcText: Sí, justo enfrente cruzando la calle, y le prepararemos el informe completo. ¡Que se mejore pronto!
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, HOOS-to en-FREN-teh kroo-SAN-do lah KAH-yeh, ee leh preh-pah-rah-REH-mos el een-FOR-meh kom-PLEH-to. Keh seh meh-HO-reh PRON-to!
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, right across the street, and we'll prepare the full report. Get well soon!

title: Madrid Bookshop Recommendation
setting: An independent bookshop in Madrid's Malasaña neighborhood lined with wooden shelves.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hola! Bienvenido a la librería. ¿Busca algún título en concreto o prefiere dejarse sorprender?
nodes.npcPhonetic: O-lah! Byen-veh-NEE-do ah lah lee-breh-REE-ah. BOOS-kah al-GOON TEE-too-lo en kon-KREH-to o preh-FYEH-reh deh-HAR-seh sor-pren-DEHR?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hello! Welcome to the bookshop. Looking for a specific title or would you rather be surprised?

choices.text: Busco una novela contemporánea en español que no sea demasiado difícil.
choices.phonetic: BOOS-ko OO-nah no-VEH-lah kon-tem-po-RAH-neh-ah en es-pah-NYOL keh no SEH-ah deh-mah-SYAH-do dee-FEE-seel.
choices.english: I'm looking for a contemporary novel in Spanish that isn't too difficult.
choices.feedback: Spot-on subjunctive ('que no sea') for describing what you're seeking!

choices.text: Me encantaría leer relatos cortos de autores españoles o latinoamericanos.
choices.phonetic: Meh en-kan-tah-REE-ah leh-EHR reh-LAH-tos KOR-tos deh ah-oo-TO-res es-pah-NYO-les o lah-tee-no-ah-meh-ree-KAH-nos.
choices.english: I'd love to read short stories by Spanish or Latin American authors.
choices.feedback: Great vocabulary: 'relatos cortos' (short stories).

nodes.npcText: Tengo una novela policiaca ambientada en Madrid con diálogos muy ágiles y capítulos breves.
nodes.npcPhonetic: TEN-go OO-nah no-VEH-lah po-lee-SYAH-kah am-byen-TAH-dah en mah-DREED kon DYAH-lo-gos mwee AH-hee-les ee kah-PEE-too-los BREH-ves.
nodes.npcEnglish: I have a detective novel set in Madrid with snappy dialogue and short chapters.

choices.text: ¡Suena ideal! Los diálogos naturales me ayudan muchísimo a aprender.
choices.phonetic: SWEH-nah ee-deh-AL! Los DYAH-lo-gos nah-too-RAH-les meh ah-YOO-dan moo-CHEE-see-mo ah ah-pren-DEHR.
choices.english: Sounds ideal! Natural dialogue helps me learn so much.
choices.feedback: Engaging and conversational—booksellers love talking reading habits.

choices.text: ¿Tiene algo más ligero, tal vez una comedia o un libro de viajes?
choices.phonetic: TYEH-neh AL-go mas lee-HEH-ro, tal ves OO-nah ko-MEH-dyah o oon LEE-bro deh VYAH-hes?
choices.english: Do you have something lighter, maybe a comedy or a travel book?
choices.feedback: Polite redirect with clear genre preferences.

nodes.npcText: Esta antología reúne cuentos modernos con humor, cotidianos y perfectos para leer en el metro.
nodes.npcPhonetic: ES-tah an-to-lo-HEE-ah reh-OO-neh KWEN-tos mo-DEHR-nos kon oo-MOR, ko-tee-DYAH-nos ee pehr-FEK-tos PAH-rah leh-EHR en el MEH-tro.
nodes.npcEnglish: This anthology collects modern stories with humor, everyday life, and perfect for reading on the metro.

choices.text: Me convence totalmente. ¿Me recomienda también algún ensayo breve?
choices.phonetic: Meh kon-VEN-seh to-tal-MEN-teh. Meh reh-ko-MYEN-dah tam-BYEN al-GOON en-SAH-yo BREH-veh?
choices.english: You've totally convinced me. Would you also recommend a short essay collection?
choices.feedback: Natural phrasing ('Me convence') and thoughtful interest.

choices.text: Déjeme hojear la primera página a ver si engancho con el estilo.
choices.phonetic: DEH-heh-meh o-heh-AR lah pree-MEH-rah PAH-hee-nah ah vehr see en-GAN-cho kon el es-TEE-lo.
choices.english: Let me flip through the first page to see if I click with the style.
choices.feedback: Super idiomatic! 'Hojear' (flip through) and 'enganchar' (get hooked) sound native.

nodes.npcText: Además organizamos un club de lectura los jueves por la tarde, por si sigue en la ciudad.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-deh-MAS or-gah-nee-SAH-mos oon kloob deh lek-TOO-rah los HWEH-ves por lah TAR-deh, por see SEE-geh en lah syoo-DAD.
nodes.npcEnglish: We also host a book club on Thursday evenings, in case you're still in town.

choices.text: ¡Qué planazo! Si tengo libre el jueves, me paso seguro.
choices.phonetic: Keh plah-NAH-so! See TEN-go LEE-breh el HWEH-ves, meh PAH-so seh-GOO-ro.
choices.english: What an awesome plan! If I'm free Thursday, I'll definitely stop by.
choices.feedback: Super authentic Madrid Spanish: '¡Qué planazo!' and 'me paso'!

choices.text: Qué buena iniciativa, me llevo el libro y un marcapáginas.
choices.phonetic: Keh BWEH-nah ee-nee-syah-TEE-vah, meh YEH-vo el LEE-bro ee oon mar-kah-PAH-hee-nas.
choices.english: What a great initiative, I'll take the book and a bookmark.
choices.feedback: Friendly and natural closing.

nodes.npcText: Tómese su tiempo, también le acerco este cuaderno de viajes por el norte de España.
nodes.npcPhonetic: TO-meh-seh soo TYEM-po, tam-BYEN leh ah-SEHR-ko ES-teh kwah-DEHR-no deh VYAH-hes por el NOR-teh deh es-PAH-nyah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Take your time, I'll also hand you this travelogue through northern Spain.

choices.text: Me atrapó el primer párrafo, me llevo los dos.
choices.phonetic: Meh ah-trah-PO el pree-MEHR PAH-rrah-fo, meh YEH-vo los dos.
choices.english: The first paragraph hooked me, I'll take both.
choices.feedback: Expressive and natural ('me atrapó').

choices.text: Este de viajes es exactamente lo que buscaba, muchas gracias.
choices.phonetic: ES-teh deh VYAH-hes es ek-sak-tah-MEN-teh lo keh boos-KAH-bah, MOO-chas GRAH-syas.
choices.english: This travel one is exactly what I was looking for, thank you very much.
choices.feedback: Warm and accurate imperfect usage ('buscaba').

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene su libro con nuestro marcapáginas de regalo. ¡Muy feliz lectura!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh soo LEE-bro kon NWES-tro mar-kah-PAH-hee-nas deh reh-GAH-lo. Mwee feh-LEES lek-TOO-rah!
nodes.npcEnglish: Here's your book with our complimentary bookmark. Happy reading!

title: Changing a Train Seat
setting: Aboard a high-speed train heading north, chatting with the friendly conductor.

nodes.npcText: Buenas tardes, billetes por favor. ¿Todo bien con su asiento en este coche?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nas TAR-des, bee-YEH-tes por fah-VOR. TO-do byen kon soo ah-SYEN-to en ES-teh KO-cheh?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good afternoon, tickets please. Everything okay with your seat in this car?

choices.text: Aquí está mi billete. Disculpe, ¿habría algún asiento libre en el sentido de la marcha?
choices.phonetic: Ah-KEE es-TAH mee bee-YEH-teh. Dees-KOOL-peh, ah-BREE-ah al-GOON ah-SYEN-to LEE-breh en el sen-TEE-do deh lah MAR-chah?
choices.english: Here is my ticket. Excuse me, might there be a free forward-facing seat?
choices.feedback: Impressive! 'En el sentido de la marcha' is the exact Spanish rail expression for forward-facing!

choices.text: Todo bien, solo quería preguntar si el coche cafetería ya está abierto.
choices.phonetic: TO-do byen, SO-lo keh-REE-ah preh-goon-TAR see el KO-cheh kah-feh-teh-REE-ah yah es-TAH ah-BYEHR-to.
choices.english: All good, I just wanted to ask if the café car is open yet.
choices.feedback: Courteous and smooth indirect question ('quería preguntar si...').

nodes.npcText: Déjeme comprobar la tableta… Sí, tras la parada de Zaragoza queda libre la ventanilla ocho A.
nodes.npcPhonetic: DEH-heh-meh kom-pro-BAR lah tah-BLEH-tah... See, tras lah pah-RAH-dah deh sah-rah-GO-sah KEH-dah LEE-breh lah ven-tah-NEE-yah O-cho ah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Let me check my tablet... Yes, after the Zaragoza stop window seat 8A opens up.

choices.text: ¡Qué maravilla! Me mareo un poco yendo de espaldas, se lo agradezco mucho.
choices.phonetic: Keh mah-rah-VEE-yah! Meh mah-REH-o oon PO-ko YEN-do deh es-PAL-das, seh lo ah-grah-DES-ko MOO-cho.
choices.english: How wonderful! I get a bit motion-sick riding backwards, I really appreciate it.
choices.feedback: Rich, authentic Spanish ('marearse', 'ir de espaldas', 'agradecer')!

choices.text: Estupendo, ¿me puedo cambiar yo mismo al salir de Zaragoza?
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do, meh PWEH-do kam-BYAR yo MEES-mo al sah-LEER deh sah-rah-GO-sah?
choices.english: Wonderful, can I move over myself once we leave Zaragoza?
choices.feedback: Polite check so there's no confusion with seat assignments.

nodes.npcText: Sí, la cafetería está dos coches más adelante y además tenemos coche en silencio justo detrás.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, lah kah-feh-teh-REE-ah es-TAH dos KO-ches mas ah-deh-LAN-teh ee ah-deh-MAS teh-NEH-mos KO-cheh en see-LEN-syo HOOS-to deh-TRAS.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, the café car is two cars ahead, and we also have a quiet car right behind.

choices.text: ¿Podría cambiarme al coche en silencio si queda hueco? Necesito leer un rato.
choices.phonetic: Po-DREE-ah kam-BYAR-meh al KO-cheh en see-LEN-syo see KEH-dah WEH-ko? Neh-seh-SEE-to leh-EHR oon RAH-to.
choices.english: Could I switch to the quiet car if there's space? I need to read for a bit.
choices.feedback: Very idiomatic! 'Si queda hueco' means 'if there's a spot open.'

choices.text: Genial, voy a por un café y vuelvo a mi sitio.
choices.phonetic: Heh-NYAL, voy ah por oon kah-FEH ee VWEL-vo ah mee SEE-tyo.
choices.english: Great, I'll go grab a coffee and come back to my seat.
choices.feedback: Authentic Spain Spanish: 'ir a por' (to go fetch/grab).

nodes.npcText: Ya le anoté el cambio en mi registro para que nadie le diga nada. Además tiene enchufe individual.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Yah leh ah-no-TEH el KAM-byo en mee reh-HEES-tro PAH-rah keh NAH-dyeh leh DEE-gah NAH-dah. Ah-deh-MAS TYEH-neh en-CHOO-feh een-dee-vee-DWAL.
nodes.npcEnglish: I've logged the seat change so nobody bothers you. It also has an individual power outlet.

choices.text: Muchísimas gracias por las molestias, así voy de lujo.
choices.phonetic: Moo-CHEE-see-mas GRAH-syas por las mo-LES-tyas, ah-SEE voy deh LOO-ho.
choices.english: Thank you so much for the trouble, I'll be riding in total comfort.
choices.feedback: Awesome colloquial touch: 'ir de lujo' (to be super comfortable)!

choices.text: Perfecto, me viene genial el enchufe para cargar el móvil.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, meh VYEH-neh heh-NYAL el en-CHOO-feh PAH-rah kar-GAR el MO-veel.
choices.english: Perfect, the outlet comes in handy to charge my phone.
choices.feedback: Natural and clear.

nodes.npcText: Sin problema, solo recoja su abrigo y la mochila. Llegamos puntuales a destino en hora y media.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Seen pro-BLEH-mah, SO-lo reh-KO-hah soo ah-BREE-go ee lah mo-CHEE-lah. Yeh-GAH-mos poon-TWAH-les ah des-TEE-no en O-rah ee MEH-dyah.
nodes.npcEnglish: No problem, just grab your coat and backpack. We'll arrive on time in an hour and a half.

choices.text: Qué puntualidad. Gracias por su amabilidad.
choices.phonetic: Keh poon-twah-lee-DAD. GRAH-syas por soo ah-mah-bee-lee-DAD.
choices.english: Such punctuality. Thank you for your kindness.
choices.feedback: Polite and pleasant.

choices.text: Estupendo, así me da tiempo a terminar mi libro.
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do, ah-SEE meh dah TYEM-po ah tehr-mee-NAR mee LEE-bro.
choices.english: Wonderful, that gives me time to finish my book.
choices.feedback: Natural conversational warmth.

nodes.npcText: ¡Para eso estamos! Avíseme si necesita cualquier otra cosa durante el trayecto.
nodes.npcPhonetic: PAH-rah EH-so es-TAH-mos! Ah-VEE-seh-meh see neh-seh-SEE-tah kwal-KYEHR O-trah KO-sah doo-RAN-teh el trah-YEK-to.
nodes.npcEnglish: That's what we're here for! Let me know if you need anything else during the journey.

title: Meeting a Host Family
setting: A warm family kitchen in Salamanca during your first evening homestay dinner.

nodes.npcText: ¡Bienvenido a casa! Esperamos que hayas tenido un buen viaje. ¿Tienes hambre después del tren?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Byen-veh-NEE-do ah KAH-sah! Es-peh-RAH-mos keh AH-yas teh-NEE-do oon bwen VYAH-heh. TYEH-nes AM-breh des-PWES del tren?
nodes.npcEnglish: Welcome home! We hope you had a good trip. Are you hungry after the train?

choices.text: ¡Muchas gracias por recibirme! Un poco sí, y la casa huele de maravilla.
choices.phonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas por reh-see-BEER-meh! Oon PO-ko see, ee lah KAH-sah WEH-leh deh mah-rah-VEE-yah.
choices.english: Thank you so much for welcoming me! A bit yes, and the house smells amazing.
choices.feedback: Warm, appreciative, and complimentary—the best first impression with a host family!

choices.text: El viaje fue muy tranquilo. Les traje unos dulces típicos de mi ciudad.
choices.phonetic: El VYAH-heh fweh mwee tran-KEE-lo. Les TRAH-heh OO-nos DOOL-ses TEE-pee-kos deh mee syoo-DAD.
choices.english: The trip was very smooth. I brought you some local treats from my hometown.
choices.feedback: Thoughtful host-gift etiquette phrased naturally!

nodes.npcText: ¡Qué majo! Preparé sopa castellana y tortilla recién hecha. Siéntate como en tu casa.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Keh MAH-ho! Preh-pah-REH SO-pah kas-teh-YAH-nah ee tor-TEE-yah reh-SYEN EH-chah. SYEN-tah-teh KO-mo en too KAH-sah.
nodes.npcEnglish: How sweet of you! I made Castilian soup and fresh potato omelette. Make yourself at home.

choices.text: ¿Puedo ayudar a poner la mesa o a llevar los vasos?
choices.phonetic: PWEH-do ah-yoo-DAR ah po-NEHR lah MEH-sah o ah yeh-VAR los VAH-sos?
choices.english: Can I help set the table or carry the glasses?
choices.feedback: Golden houseguest phrase: 'poner la mesa' (set the table)!

choices.text: Nunca he probado la sopa castellana, ¡qué ilusión probarla casera!
choices.phonetic: NOON-kah eh pro-BAH-do lah SO-pah kas-teh-YAH-nah, keh ee-loo-SYON pro-BAR-lah kah-SEH-rah!
choices.english: I've never tried Castilian soup—how exciting to taste it homemade!
choices.feedback: Awesome idiom: '¡qué ilusión!' expresses genuine delight.

nodes.npcText: ¡Qué detalle tan bonito, no hacía falta! Los abriremos luego con el café en la sobremesa.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Keh deh-TAH-yeh tan bo-NEE-to, no ah-SEE-ah FAL-tah! Los ah-bree-REH-mos LWEH-go kon el kah-FEH en lah so-breh-MEH-sah.
nodes.npcEnglish: What a lovely gesture, you didn't have to! We'll open them later with coffee during after-dinner chat.

choices.text: Me encanta la costumbre española de la sobremesa. ¿En qué echo una mano?
choices.phonetic: Meh en-KAN-tah lah kos-TOOM-breh es-pah-NYO-lah deh lah so-breh-MEH-sah. En keh EH-cho OO-nah MAH-no?
choices.english: I love the Spanish tradition of lingering at the table. Where can I lend a hand?
choices.feedback: Culturally tuned-in plus great idiom: 'echar una mano' (lend a hand)!

choices.text: Espero que les gusten. ¿A qué hora suelen cenar normalmente?
choices.phonetic: Es-PEH-ro keh les GOOS-ten. Ah keh OH-rah SWEH-len seh-NAR nor-mal-MEN-teh?
choices.english: I hope you like them. What time do you normally have dinner?
choices.feedback: Great use of 'soler' (to usually do) to learn household routines.

nodes.npcText: Si quieres, pasa la jarra de agua a la mesa. Mañana te enseño el camino más corto a la academia.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See KYEH-res, PAH-sah lah HAH-rrah deh AH-gwah ah lah MEH-sah. Mah-NYAH-nah teh en-SEH-nyo el kah-MEE-no mas KOR-to ah lah ah-kah-DEH-myah.
nodes.npcEnglish: If you like, bring the water pitcher to the table. Tomorrow I'll show you the shortest route to the school.

choices.text: ¡Fenomenal! Así me acostumbro pronto al barrio.
choices.phonetic: Feh-no-meh-NAL! Ah-SEE meh ah-kos-TOOM-bro PRON-to al BAH-rryo.
choices.english: Awesome! That way I'll get used to the neighborhood quickly.
choices.feedback: Natural and upbeat ('acostumbrarse a').

choices.text: Gracias de verdad, y si me corrigen cuando cometa fallos de español, mejor todavía.
choices.phonetic: GRAH-syas deh vehr-DAD, ee see meh ko-RREE-hen KWAN-do ko-MEH-tah FAH-yos deh es-pah-NYOL, meh-HOR to-dah-VEE-ah.
choices.english: Thank you truly, and if you correct me when I make Spanish mistakes, even better.
choices.feedback: Humble, warm, and uses the subjunctive ('cuando cometa') smoothly!

nodes.npcText: Aquí cenamos sobre las nueve y media, y los fines de semana nos gusta charlar sin prisa.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE seh-NAH-mos SO-breh las NWEH-veh ee MEH-dyah, ee los FEE-nes deh seh-MAH-nah nos GOOS-tah char-LAR seen PREE-sah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Here we dine around nine-thirty, and on weekends we love chatting unhurriedly.

choices.text: Me viene genial ese horario, me va a ayudar muchísimo con la fluidez.
choices.phonetic: Meh VYEH-neh heh-NYAL EH-seh o-RAH-ryo, meh vah ah ah-yoo-DAR moo-CHEE-see-mo kon lah flwee-DES.
choices.english: That schedule works great for me, it's going to help my fluency so much.
choices.feedback: Warm, natural enthusiasm!

choices.text: Perfecto, me adapto sin problema. ¡Qué rica está la cena!
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, meh ah-DAP-to seen pro-BLEH-mah. Keh REE-kah es-TAH lah SEH-nah!
choices.english: Perfect, I'll adapt easily. Dinner tastes so delicious!
choices.feedback: Complimenting home cooking ('¡Qué rica!') always delights hosts.

nodes.npcText: ¡Seguro que en un mes hablas como un salmantino más! Venga, a cenar antes de que se enfríe.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Seh-GOO-ro keh en oon mes AH-blas KO-mo oon sal-man-TEE-no mas! VEN-gah, ah seh-NAR AN-tes deh keh seh en-FREE-eh.
nodes.npcEnglish: I bet in a month you'll talk like a local from Salamanca! Come on, let's eat before it gets cold.

title: Flat Viewing in Chamberí
setting: A bright third-floor Madrid apartment viewing with the landlord.

nodes.npcText: Como ve, el piso da a un patio ajardinado muy tranquilo y se reformó por completo hace dos años.
nodes.npcPhonetic: KO-mo veh, el PEE-so dah ah oon PAH-tyo ah-har-dee-NAH-do mwee tran-KEE-lo ee seh reh-for-MO por kom-PLEH-to AH-seh dos AH-nyos.
nodes.npcEnglish: As you can see, the flat overlooks a very quiet garden courtyard and was fully renovated two years ago.

choices.text: La luz natural es fantástica. ¿Los gastos de comunidad y calefacción están incluidos en la renta?
choices.phonetic: Lah loos nah-too-RAL es fan-TAS-tee-kah. Los GAS-tos deh ko-moo-nee-DAD ee kah-leh-fak-SYON es-TAN een-kloo-EE-dos en lah REN-tah?
choices.english: The natural light is fantastic. Are building fees and heating included in the rent?
choices.feedback: Precise housing vocabulary ('gastos de comunidad', 'renta') paired with warmth.

choices.text: Me encanta la distribución. ¿Qué duración mínima plantea para el contrato?
choices.phonetic: Meh en-KAN-tah lah dees-tree-boo-SYON. Keh doo-rah-SYON MEE-nee-mah plan-TEH-ah PAH-rah el kon-TRAH-to?
choices.english: I love the layout. What minimum lease duration do you have in mind?
choices.feedback: Polite, executive phrasing ('plantear' = to propose/have in mind).

nodes.npcText: La comunidad corre a mi cargo; los suministros de luz, agua e internet van aparte según consumo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Lah ko-moo-nee-DAD KO-rreh ah mee KAR-go; los soo-mee-NEES-tros deh loos, AH-gwah eh een-tehr-NET van ah-PAR-teh seh-GOON kon-SOO-mo.
nodes.npcEnglish: Building fees are on me; electricity, water, and internet utilities are billed separately by usage.

choices.text: Queda clarísimo. ¿A cuánto asciende la fianza y en qué plazo se devuelve al finalizar?
choices.phonetic: KEH-dah klah-REE-see-mo. Ah KWAN-to ah-SYEN-deh lah FYAN-sah ee en keh PLAH-so seh deh-VWEL-veh al fee-nah-lee-SAR?
choices.english: Crystal clear. How much is the deposit and within what timeframe is it returned at lease end?
choices.feedback: Top-level formal Spanish: '¿A cuánto asciende...?' and 'fianza' (deposit).

choices.text: ¿Cuenta el edificio con buen aislamiento acústico frente al ruido de la calle?
choices.phonetic: KWEN-tah el eh-dee-FEE-syo kon bwen ah-ees-lah-MYEN-to ah-KOOS-tee-ko FREN-teh al RWEE-do deh lah KAH-yeh?
choices.english: Does the building have good soundproofing against street noise?
choices.feedback: Smart tenant inquiry using 'aislamiento acústico'.

nodes.npcText: Busco un inquilino estable para al menos un año, renovable conforme a la ley vigente.
nodes.npcPhonetic: BOOS-ko oon een-kee-LEE-no es-TAH-bleh PAH-rah al MEH-nos oon AH-nyo, reh-no-VAH-bleh kon-FOR-meh ah lah ley vee-HEN-teh.
nodes.npcEnglish: I'm looking for a stable tenant for at least a year, renewable under current housing law.

choices.text: Me encaja perfectamente. ¿Aceptaría una cláusula de preaviso de treinta días tras el primer semestre?
choices.phonetic: Meh en-KAH-hah pehr-fek-tah-MEN-teh. Ah-sep-tah-REE-ah OO-nah KLAH-oo-soo-lah deh preh-ah-VEE-so deh TREYN-tah DEE-as tras el pree-MEHR seh-MES-treh?
choices.english: That fits me well. Would you accept a thirty-day notice clause after the first six months?
choices.feedback: Diplomatic negotiation phrasing with precise legal vocabulary ('preaviso').

choices.text: ¿Habría algún inconveniente en teletrabajar y dar de alta fibra de alta velocidad?
choices.phonetic: Ah-BREE-ah al-GOON een-kon-veh-NYEN-teh en teh-leh-trah-bah-HAR ee dar deh AL-tah FEE-brah deh AL-tah veh-lo-see-DAD?
choices.english: Would there be any issue working remotely and setting up high-speed fiber?
choices.feedback: Very idiomatic: 'dar de alta' (to sign up for/activate a utility).

nodes.npcText: Es un mes de fianza legal depositado en el organismo autonómico, y el preaviso de treinta días me parece razonable.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es oon mes deh FYAN-sah leh-GAL deh-po-see-TAH-do en el or-gah-NEES-mo ah-oo-to-NO-mee-ko, ee el preh-ah-VEE-so deh TREYN-tah DEE-as meh pah-REH-seh rah-so-NAH-bleh.
nodes.npcEnglish: It's one month's legal deposit held with the regional housing agency, and thirty days' notice sounds reasonable.

choices.text: Agradezco tanta transparencia. Si le envío hoy la documentación, ¿podríamos formalizar el borrador esta semana?
choices.phonetic: Ah-grah-DES-ko TAN-tah trans-pah-REN-syah. See leh en-VEE-o oy lah do-koo-men-tah-SYON, po-DREE-ah-mos for-mah-lee-SAR el bo-rrah-DOR ES-tah seh-MAH-nah?
choices.english: I appreciate such transparency. If I send my paperwork today, could we finalize the draft this week?
choices.feedback: Polished, decisive, and courteous closing.

choices.text: Perfecto, me gustaría revisarlo con calma esta noche y confirmarle mañana a primera hora.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, meh goos-tah-REE-ah reh-vee-SAR-lo kon KAL-mah ES-tah NO-cheh ee kon-feer-MAR-leh mah-NYAH-nah ah pree-MEH-rah O-rah.
choices.english: Perfect, I'd like to review it carefully tonight and confirm first thing tomorrow.
choices.feedback: Professional boundary-setting ('a primera hora' = first thing).

nodes.npcText: Las ventanas son de doble acristalamiento y la fibra ya llega instalada hasta el salón.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Las ven-TAH-nas son deh DO-bleh ah-krees-tah-lah-MYEN-to ee lah FEE-brah yah YEH-gah een-stah-LAH-dah AH-stah el sah-LON.
nodes.npcEnglish: The windows are double-glazed and fiber is already wired into the living room.

choices.text: Eso resuelve todas mis dudas. Cuente con mi solicitud esta misma tarde.
choices.phonetic: EH-so reh-SWEL-veh TO-das mees DOO-das. KWEN-teh kon mee so-lee-see-TOOD ES-tah MEES-mah TAR-deh.
choices.english: That resolves all my questions. Count on my application this very afternoon.
choices.feedback: Confident and natural executive Spanish!

choices.text: Excelente, ¿hacemos también un inventario fotográfico del mobiliario antes de entrar?
choices.phonetic: Ek-seh-LEN-teh, ah-SEH-mos tam-BYEN oon een-ven-TAH-ryo fo-to-GRAH-fee-ko del mo-bee-LYAH-ryo AN-tes deh en-TRAR?
choices.english: Excellent, shall we also do a photo inventory of the furnishings before move-in?
choices.feedback: Savvy and diplomatic way to protect both parties.

nodes.npcText: Por supuesto, haremos inventario detallado y le mando el borrador del contrato hoy mismo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Por soo-PWES-to, ah-REH-mos een-ven-TAH-ryo deh-tah-YAH-do ee leh MAN-do el bo-rrah-DOR del kon-TRAH-to oy MEES-mo.
nodes.npcEnglish: Of course, we'll make a detailed inventory and I'll send you the draft lease today.

title: Rioja Wine Cellar Tasting
setting: A vaulted stone winery cellar in Haro, La Rioja, sampling aged vintages.

nodes.npcText: Bienvenidos a nuestra cava centenaria. Empezaremos comparando un crianza y un reserva de la misma parcela.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Byen-veh-NEE-dos ah NWES-trah KAH-vah sen-teh-NAH-ryah. Em-peh-sah-REH-mos kom-pah-RAN-do oon kree-AN-sah ee oon reh-SEHR-vah deh lah MEES-mah par-SEH-lah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Welcome to our century-old cellar. We'll begin by comparing a Crianza and a Reserva from the same plot.

choices.text: Qué privilegio probarlos en paralelo. ¿Predomina aquí la uva tempranillo o incorporan graciano?
choices.phonetic: Keh pree-vee-LEH-hyo pro-BAR-los en pah-rah-LEH-lo. Preh-do-MEE-nah ah-KEE lah OO-vah tem-prah-NEE-yo o een-kor-PO-ran grah-SYAH-no?
choices.english: What a privilege to taste them side by side. Is Tempranillo dominant here, or do you blend Graciano?
choices.feedback: Impressive enological precision and elegant phrasing!

choices.text: Me intriga notar cómo influye el tipo de roble en los aromas terciarios.
choices.phonetic: Meh een-TREE-gah no-TAR KO-mo een-FLOO-yeh el TEE-po deh RO-bleh en los ah-RO-mas tehr-SYAH-ryos.
choices.english: I'm intrigued to notice how the oak type influences the tertiary aromas.
choices.feedback: Sophisticated tasting vocabulary ('roble', 'aromas terciarios').

nodes.npcText: Es un ochenta y cinco por ciento tempranillo con un toque de graciano que aporta frescura y nervio.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Es oon o-CHEN-tah ee SEEN-ko por SYEN-to tem-prah-NEE-yo kon oon TO-keh deh grah-SYAH-no keh ah-POR-tah fres-KOO-rah ee NEHR-vyo.
nodes.npcEnglish: It's eighty-five percent Tempranillo with a touch of Graciano that adds freshness and vitality.

choices.text: En nariz destacan frutos rojos maduros y un fondo sutil de vainilla muy equilibrado.
choices.phonetic: En nah-REES des-TAH-kan FROO-tos RO-hos mah-DOO-ros ee oon FON-do soo-TEEL deh vy-NEE-yah mwee eh-kee-lee-BRAH-do.
choices.english: On the nose ripe red berries stand out with a subtle, well-balanced vanilla undertone.
choices.feedback: Sounds straight out of a Rioja sommelier panel ('en nariz', 'equilibrado')!

choices.text: Con la acidez tan viva que tiene, supongo que evolucionará muy bien en botella.
choices.phonetic: Kon lah ah-see-DES tan VEE-vah keh TYEH-neh, soo-POHN-go keh eh-vo-loo-syo-nah-RAH mwee byen en bo-TEH-yah.
choices.english: With such lively acidity, I assume it will age very nicely in bottle.
choices.feedback: Thoughtful observation using future of conjecture.

nodes.npcText: Combinamos barrica de roble americano y francés para no enmascarar el carácter del viñedo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Kom-bee-NAH-mos bah-RREE-kah deh RO-bleh ah-meh-ree-KAH-no ee fran-SES PAH-rah no en-mas-kah-RAR el kah-RAK-tehr del vee-NYEH-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: We combine American and French oak barrels so as not to mask the vineyard's character.

choices.text: Se nota en boca: el tanino está muy pulido y el final resulta largo y sedoso.
choices.phonetic: Seh NO-tah en BO-kah: el tah-NEE-no es-TAH mwee poo-LEE-do ee el fee-NAL reh-SOOL-tah LAR-go ee seh-DO-so.
choices.english: You can tell on the palate: the tannins are finely polished and the finish is long and silky.
choices.feedback: Masterful tasting notes ('en boca', 'tanino pulido', 'sedoso')!

choices.text: ¿Con qué plato tradicional riojano maridaría usted este reserva?
choices.phonetic: Kon keh PLAH-to trah-dee-syo-NAL ryo-HAH-no mah-ree-dah-REE-ah oos-TED ES-teh reh-SEHR-vah?
choices.english: Which traditional Riojan dish would you pair this Reserva with?
choices.feedback: Great gastronomic verb: 'maridar' (to pair wine and food).

nodes.npcText: ¡Tiene un paladar estupendo! En las añadas frescas buscamos justo esa elegancia sin exceso de madera.
nodes.npcPhonetic: TYEH-neh oon pah-lah-DAR es-too-PEN-do! En las ah-NYAH-das FRES-kas boos-KAH-mos HOOS-to EH-sah eh-leh-GAN-syah seen ek-SEH-so deh mah-DEH-rah.
nodes.npcEnglish: You have a wonderful palate! In cooler vintages we aim for exactly that elegance without heavy oak.

choices.text: ¿Realizan envíos internacionales si decido llevarme una caja surtida?
choices.phonetic: Reh-ah-LEE-san en-VEE-os een-tehr-nah-syo-NAH-les see deh-SEE-do yeh-VAR-meh OO-nah KAH-hah soor-TEE-dah?
choices.english: Do you ship internationally if I decide to order a mixed case?
choices.feedback: Smooth and practical ('caja surtida' = mixed case).

choices.text: Me ha fascinado comparar ambas crianzas; me llevo un par de botellas del reserva.
choices.phonetic: Meh ah fas-see-NAH-do kom-pah-RAR AM-bas kree-AN-sas; meh YEH-vo oon par deh bo-TEH-yas del reh-SEHR-vah.
choices.english: Comparing both aging styles fascinated me; I'll take a couple of bottles of the Reserva.
choices.feedback: Warm, cultured wrap-up.

nodes.npcText: Unas chuletillas al sarmiento o unas patatas a la riojana le hacen justicia como pocos platos.
nodes.npcPhonetic: OO-nas choo-leh-TEE-yas al sar-MYEN-to o OO-nas pah-TAH-tas ah lah ryo-HAH-nah leh AH-sen hoos-TEE-syah KO-mo PO-kos PLAH-tos.
nodes.npcEnglish: Lamb chops grilled over vine shoots or Riojan potatoes do it justice like few dishes can.

choices.text: Tomo nota para la cena de esta noche, ¡muchísimas gracias por una cata inolvidable!
choices.phonetic: TO-mo NO-tah PAH-rah lah SEH-nah deh ES-tah NO-cheh, moo-CHEE-see-mas GRAH-syas por OO-nah KAH-tah een-ol-vee-DAH-bleh!
choices.english: I'll take note for tonight's dinner—thank you so much for an unforgettable tasting!
choices.feedback: Natural idiom ('tomar nota') and genuine warmth.

choices.text: Con su permiso, paso por la tienda a elegir un estuche para guardar unos años.
choices.phonetic: Kon soo pehr-MEE-so, PAH-so por lah TYEN-dah ah eh-leh-HEER oon es-TOO-cheh PAH-rah gwar-DAR OO-nos AH-nyos.
choices.english: With your permission, I'll stop by the shop to pick a gift box to cellar for a few years.
choices.feedback: Refined and gracious closing.

nodes.npcText: Enviamos a toda Europa y América con embalaje térmico. ¡Salud y gracias por visitarnos!
nodes.npcPhonetic: En-VYAH-mos ah TO-dah eh-oo-RO-pah ee ah-MEH-ree-kah kon em-bah-LAH-heh TEHR-mee-ko. Sah-LOOD ee GRAH-syas por vee-see-TAR-nos!
nodes.npcEnglish: We ship across Europe and the Americas with thermal packaging. Cheers and thanks for visiting!

title: Tech Meetup in Barcelona
setting: An evening product showcase at a converted loft in Barcelona's Poblenou district.

nodes.npcText: ¡Buenas! Me gustó mucho tu pregunta al ponente sobre accesibilidad móvil. ¿Trabajas en diseño o ingeniería?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nas! Meh goos-TO MOO-cho too preh-GOON-tah al po-NEN-teh SO-breh ak-seh-see-bee-lee-DAD MO-veel. Trah-BAH-has en dee-SEH-nyo o een-heh-nyeh-REE-ah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Hey! I really liked your question to the speaker about mobile accessibility. Do you work in design or engineering?

choices.text: ¡Gracias! Estoy a caballo entre producto e ingeniería, y justo estamos rediseñando nuestra app educativa.
choices.phonetic: GRAH-syas! Es-TOY ah kah-BAH-yo EN-treh pro-DOOK-to eh een-heh-nyeh-REE-ah, ee HOOS-to es-TAH-mos reh-dee-seh-NYAN-do NWES-trah ap eh-doo-kah-TEE-vah.
choices.english: Thanks! I straddle product and engineering, and we're actually redesigning our educational app.
choices.feedback: Stellar native idiom: 'estar a caballo entre' (to straddle two disciplines)!

choices.text: Vengo del lado técnico, pero cada vez me involucro más en investigación con usuarios.
choices.phonetic: VEN-go del LAH-do TEK-nee-ko, PEH-ro KAH-dah ves meh een-vo-LOO-kro mas en een-ves-tee-gah-SYON kon oo-SWAH-ryos.
choices.english: I come from the technical side, though I'm getting increasingly involved in user research.
choices.feedback: Natural professional self-introduction.

nodes.npcText: Qué interesante. Aquí en el ecosistema de Poblenou hay muchísimo talento en tecnología educativa. ¿Qué reto principal enfrentan?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Keh een-teh-reh-SAN-teh. Ah-KEE en el eh-ko-sees-TEH-mah deh po-bleh-NO-oo eye moo-CHEE-see-mo tah-LEN-to en tek-no-lo-HEE-ah eh-doo-kah-TEE-vah. Keh REH-to preen-see-PAL en-FREN-tan?
nodes.npcEnglish: How interesting. Here in the Poblenou ecosystem there's huge talent in edtech. What's your main challenge?

choices.text: Lograr que la experiencia funcione igual de fluida sin conexión y con latencia mínima.
choices.phonetic: Lo-GRAR keh lah eks-peh-RYEN-syah foon-SYO-neh ee-GWAL deh FLWEE-dah seen ko-nek-SYON ee kon lah-TEN-syah MEE-nee-mah.
choices.english: Making sure the experience runs just as smoothly offline with minimal latency.
choices.feedback: Crisp technical Spanish ('sin conexión', 'latencia mínima') + smooth subjunctive!

choices.text: Equilibrar el rigor pedagógico con una interfaz lúdica que enganche a diario.
choices.phonetic: Eh-kee-lee-BRAR el ree-GOR peh-dah-GO-hee-ko kon OO-nah een-tehr-FAS LOO-dee-kah keh en-GAN-cheh ah DYAH-ryo.
choices.english: Balancing pedagogical rigor with a playful interface that hooks learners daily.
choices.feedback: Rich, expressive phrasing ('lúdica', 'que enganche').

nodes.npcText: Esa mezcla es oro puro. Cuando ingeniería escucha directamente a usuarios reales, el producto despega.
nodes.npcPhonetic: EH-sah MES-klah es O-ro POO-ro. KWAN-do een-heh-nyeh-REE-ah es-KOO-chah dee-rek-tah-MEN-teh ah oo-SWAH-ryos reh-AH-les, el pro-DOOK-to des-PEH-gah.
nodes.npcEnglish: That blend is pure gold. When engineering listens directly to real users, the product takes off.

choices.text: Totalmente de acuerdo; en una sola sesión de pruebas detectas fricciones que nadie veía en Figma.
choices.phonetic: To-tal-MEN-teh deh ah-KWEHR-do; en OO-nah SO-lah seh-SYON deh PRWEH-bas deh-TEK-tas freek-SYO-nes keh NAH-dyeh veh-EE-ah en FEEG-mah.
choices.english: Totally agree; in a single usability session you spot friction nobody saw in Figma.
choices.feedback: Authentic tech-meetup conversational flow!

choices.text: ¿Y tú en qué proyecto andas metida ahora? Me encantaría conocerlo.
choices.phonetic: Ee too en keh pro-YEK-to AN-das meh-TEE-dah ah-O-rah? Meh en-kan-tah-REE-ah ko-no-SEHR-lo.
choices.english: And what project are you diving into right now? I'd love to hear about it.
choices.feedback: Natural networking reciprocation ('andar metido en' = to be working on).

nodes.npcText: Tal cual. Justo montamos un grupo pequeño de producto móvil cada mes para compartir métricas y aprendizajes.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Tal kwal. HOOS-to mon-TAH-mos oon GROO-po peh-KEH-nyo deh pro-DOOK-to MO-veel KAH-dah mes PAH-rah kom-par-TEER MEH-tree-kas ee ah-pren-dee-SAH-hes.
nodes.npcEnglish: Spot on. We actually run a small mobile product group every month to share metrics and lessons.

choices.text: Me apunto sin dudarlo. ¿Intercambiamos contacto y me pasas la próxima convocatoria?
choices.phonetic: Meh ah-POON-to seen doo-DAR-lo. Een-tehr-kam-BYAH-mos kon-TAK-to ee meh PAH-sas lah PROK-see-mah kon-vo-kah-TO-ryah?
choices.english: Count me in without hesitation. Shall we swap contacts and you send me the next invite?
choices.feedback: Super natural! 'Me apunto' + 'convocatoria' sounds effortlessly fluent.

choices.text: Suena enriquecedor. Si encaja, incluso podría presentar un caso práctico sobre diseño offline.
choices.phonetic: SWEH-nah en-ree-keh-seh-DOR. See en-KAH-hah, een-KLOO-so po-DREE-ah preh-sen-TAR oon KAH-so PRAK-tee-ko SO-breh dee-SEH-nyo of-LYN.
choices.english: Sounds enriching. If it fits, I could even share a case study on offline-first design.
choices.feedback: Proactive, polished contribution offer.

nodes.npcText: Lidero una herramienta de voz para aulas multilingües, así que tenemos muchísimo en común.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Lee-DEH-ro OO-nah eh-rrah-MYEN-tah deh vos PAH-rah AH-oo-las mool-tee-LEEN-gwes, ah-SEE keh teh-NEH-mos moo-CHEE-see-mo en ko-MOON.
nodes.npcEnglish: I lead a voice tool for multilingual classrooms, so we have a ton in common.

choices.text: ¡Qué coincidencia! Tomemos un café la semana que viene y comparamos notas.
choices.phonetic: Keh ko-een-see-DEN-syah! To-MEH-mos oon kah-FEH lah seh-MAH-nah keh VYEH-neh ee kom-pah-RAH-mos NO-tas.
choices.english: What a coincidence! Let's grab coffee next week and compare notes.
choices.feedback: Warm, genuine networking follow-through.

choices.text: Me encantaría probar una demo cuando tengan tiempo; parece un reto apasionante.
choices.phonetic: Meh en-kan-tah-REE-ah pro-BAR OO-nah DEH-mo KWAN-do TEN-gan TYEM-po; pah-REH-seh oon REH-to ah-pah-syo-NAN-teh.
choices.english: I'd love to try a demo whenever you have time; it sounds like a thrilling challenge.
choices.feedback: Engaging and uses subjunctive ('cuando tengan') cleanly.

nodes.npcText: ¡Hecho! Aquí tienes mi contacto. Nos escribimos mañana para concretar día y hora.
nodes.npcPhonetic: EH-cho! Ah-KEE TYEH-nes mee kon-TAK-to. Nos es-kree-BEE-mos mah-NYAH-nah PAH-rah kon-kreh-TAR DEE-ah ee O-rah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Done! Here's my contact. We'll message tomorrow to lock in a day and time.

title: Opening a Local Bank Account
setting: A quiet glass advisory office inside a neighborhood bank branch in Valencia.

nodes.npcText: Buenos días, tome asiento. Entiendo que desea abrir una cuenta corriente para gestionar sus gastos aquí.
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as, TO-meh ah-SYEN-to. En-TYEN-do keh deh-SEH-ah ah-BREER OO-nah KWEN-tah ko-RRYEN-teh PAH-rah hes-tyo-NAR soos GAS-tos ah-KEE.
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning, please have a seat. I understand you'd like to open a checking account for local expenses.

choices.text: Exacto. Acabo de obtener mi NIE y necesito domiciliar el alquiler y los recibos.
choices.phonetic: Ek-SAK-to. Ah-KAH-bo deh ob-teh-NEHR mee NEE-eh ee neh-seh-SEE-to do-mee-see-LYAR el al-kee-LEHR ee los reh-SEE-bos.
choices.english: Exactly. I just got my NIE and need to set up direct debit for rent and bills.
choices.feedback: Spot-on Spanish banking vocabulary: 'NIE' and 'domiciliar recibos'!

choices.text: Sí, pero antes quisiera conocer qué comisiones de mantenimiento y cambio de divisa aplican.
choices.phonetic: See, PEH-ro AN-tes kee-SYEH-rah ko-no-SEHR keh ko-mee-SYO-nes deh man-teh-nee-MYEN-to ee KAM-byo deh dee-VEE-sah ah-PLEE-kan.
choices.english: Yes, though first I'd like to know what maintenance and currency-exchange fees apply.
choices.feedback: Clear, assertive financial questioning.

nodes.npcText: Con el NIE y el certificado de empadronamiento podemos abrirla hoy mismo sin comisiones si domicilia nómina.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Kon el NEE-eh ee el sehr-tee-fee-KAH-do deh em-pah-dro-nah-MYEN-to po-DEH-mos ah-BREER-lah oy MEES-mo seen ko-mee-SYO-nes see do-mee-see-LYAH NO-mee-nah.
nodes.npcEnglish: With your NIE and residency registration we can open it today with zero fees if you deposit your salary.

choices.text: Trabajo como autónomo; ¿existe alguna alternativa sin nómina fija que evite comisiones?
choices.phonetic: Trah-BAH-ho KO-mo ah-oo-TO-no-mo; ek-SEES-teh al-GOO-nah al-tehr-nah-TEE-vah seen NO-mee-nah FEE-hah keh eh-VEE-teh ko-mee-SYO-nes?
choices.english: I'm self-employed; is there an alternative without a fixed payroll that avoids fees?
choices.feedback: Real-world Spain accuracy ('autónomo') plus sharp subjunctive ('que evite')!

choices.text: Traigo el contrato de alquiler, pero el empadronamiento me lo entregan el lunes. ¿Sirve provisionalmente?
choices.phonetic: TRY-go el kon-TRAH-to deh al-kee-LEHR, PEH-ro el em-pah-dro-nah-MYEN-to meh lo en-TREH-gan el LOO-nes. SEER-veh pro-vee-syo-nal-MEN-teh?
choices.english: I brought my lease, though my town-hall registration arrives Monday. Does this work provisionally?
choices.feedback: Very practical negotiation of paperwork timing.

nodes.npcText: La cuenta digital no tiene comisión de mantenimiento y las transferencias SEPA en euros son gratuitas.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Lah KWEN-tah dee-hee-TAL no TYEH-neh ko-mee-SYON deh man-teh-nee-MYEN-to ee las trans-feh-REN-syas SEH-pah en EH-oo-ros son grah-TWEE-tas.
nodes.npcEnglish: The digital account has no maintenance fee and euro SEPA transfers are free.

choices.text: ¿Y respecto a la tarjeta de débito y la retirada de efectivo en cajeros de otras entidades?
choices.phonetic: Ee res-PEK-to ah lah tar-HEH-tah deh DEH-bee-to ee lah reh-tee-RAH-dah deh eh-fek-TEE-vo en kah-HEH-ros deh O-tras en-tee-DAH-des?
choices.english: And regarding the debit card and cash withdrawals at other banks' ATMs?
choices.feedback: Polished formal banking terms ('retirada de efectivo', 'entidades').

choices.text: Me convence bastante. ¿Incluye alertas instantáneas y bloqueo temporal desde la aplicación?
choices.phonetic: Meh kon-VEN-seh bas-TAN-teh. Een-KLOO-yeh ah-LEHR-tas een-stan-TAH-neh-as ee blo-KEH-o tem-po-RAL DES-deh lah ah-plee-kah-SYON?
choices.english: That sounds compelling. Does it include instant alerts and temporary card freeze in the app?
choices.feedback: Thorough modern digital-banking check.

nodes.npcText: Sí, la cuenta para autónomos elimina comisiones con ingresos recurrentes y tiene cuatro retiradas gratis al mes.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, lah KWEN-tah PAH-rah ah-oo-TO-no-mos eh-lee-MEE-nah ko-mee-SYO-nes kon een-GREH-sos reh-koo-RREN-tes ee TYEH-neh KWAH-tro reh-tee-RAH-das GRAH-tees al mes.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, the self-employed account waives fees with recurring deposits and includes four free ATM withdrawals monthly.

choices.text: Perfecto, procedamos con la apertura entonces. Prefiero revisar el resumen contractual antes de firmar.
choices.phonetic: Pehr-FEK-to, pro-seh-DAH-mos kon lah ah-pehr-TOO-rah en-TON-ses. Preh-FYEH-ro reh-vee-SAR el reh-SOO-men kon-trak-TWAL AN-tes deh feer-MAR.
choices.english: Perfect, let's proceed with opening it then. I'd like to review the contract summary before signing.
choices.feedback: Smart, poised, and formal ('procedamos', 'resumen contractual').

choices.text: ¿Podré disponer del número IBAN hoy mismo para pasárselo a mi casero?
choices.phonetic: Po-DREH dees-po-NEHR del NOO-meh-ro ee-BAN oy MEES-mo PAH-rah pah-SAR-seh-lo ah mee kah-SEH-ro?
choices.english: Will I have the IBAN number today to pass along to my landlord?
choices.feedback: Practical real-life follow-up using 'casero' (landlord).

nodes.npcText: Sí, podemos dejarla preactivada con el contrato hoy y la aplicación incluye control total de seguridad.
nodes.npcPhonetic: See, po-DEH-mos deh-HAR-lah preh-ak-tee-VAH-dah kon el kon-TRAH-to oy ee lah ah-plee-kah-SYON een-KLOO-yeh kon-TROL to-TAL deh seh-goo-ree-DAD.
nodes.npcEnglish: Yes, we can pre-activate it with your lease today and the app includes full security controls.

choices.text: Excelente, en cuanto reciba el certificado el lunes se lo subo desde la app.
choices.phonetic: Ek-seh-LEN-teh, en KWAN-to reh-SEE-bah el sehr-tee-fee-KAH-do el LOO-nes seh lo SOO-bo DES-deh lah ap.
choices.english: Excellent, as soon as I receive the certificate Monday I'll upload it in the app.
choices.feedback: Flawless 'en cuanto + subjunctive' for a future event!

choices.text: Muchas gracias por la flexibilidad, me ha ahorrado un segundo desplazamiento.
choices.phonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas por lah flek-see-bee-lee-DAD, meh ah ah-o-RRAH-do oon seh-GOON-do des-plah-sah-MYEN-to.
choices.english: Thank you very much for the flexibility, you've saved me a second trip.
choices.feedback: Refined and gracious closing.

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene las condiciones y su IBAN provisional impreso. En cinco minutos dejamos todo firmado.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh las kon-dee-SYO-nes ee soo ee-BAN pro-vee-syo-NAL eem-PREH-so. En SEEN-ko mee-NOO-tos deh-HAH-mos TO-do feer-MAH-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: Here are the terms and your printed provisional IBAN. In five minutes we'll have everything signed.

title: Prado Museum Curator Chat
setting: Standing before Velázquez's Las Meninas during an intimate curator talk at the Prado.

nodes.npcText: Fíjense en cómo Velázquez construye la profundidad mediante planos de luz y no solo con líneas geométricas.
nodes.npcPhonetic: FEE-hen-seh en KO-mo veh-LAS-kes kon-STROO-yeh lah pro-foon-dee-DAD meh-DYAN-teh PLAH-nos deh loos ee no SO-lo kon LEE-neh-as heh-o-MEH-tree-kas.
nodes.npcEnglish: Notice how Velázquez builds depth through planes of light rather than geometric lines alone.

choices.text: Es asombroso cómo el espejo del fondo nos convierte a los espectadores en parte de la escena.
choices.phonetic: Es ah-som-BRO-so KO-mo el es-PEH-ho del FON-do nos kon-VYEHR-teh ah los es-pek-tah-DO-res en PAR-teh deh lah es-SEH-nah.
choices.english: It's astonishing how the mirror in the back turns us viewers into part of the scene.
choices.feedback: Eloquent art commentary with natural flow!

choices.text: Siempre me ha llamado la atención lo suelta que resulta su pincelada cuando uno se acerca.
choices.phonetic: SYEM-preh meh ah yah-MAH-do lah ah-ten-SYON lo SWEL-tah keh reh-SOOL-tah soo peen-seh-LAH-dah KWAN-do OO-no seh ah-SEHR-kah.
choices.english: I've always been struck by how loose his brushwork looks when you step closer.
choices.feedback: Brilliant Spanish structure: 'lo + adjective + que' ('lo suelta que resulta')!

nodes.npcText: Exacto, juega con la ambigüedad de quién posa realmente. ¿Conocía la teoría sobre la cruz de Santiago en su pecho?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ek-SAK-to, HWEH-gah kon lah am-bee-gweh-DAD deh kyen PO-sah reh-al-MEN-teh. Ko-no-SEE-ah lah teh-o-REE-ah SO-breh lah kroos deh san-TYAH-go en soo PEH-cho?
nodes.npcEnglish: Exactly, he plays with the ambiguity of who is truly posing. Have you heard the theory about the Cross of Santiago on his chest?

choices.text: Leí que se añadió años después, cuando por fin le concedieron el título nobiliario.
choices.phonetic: Leh-EE keh seh ah-nyah-DYO AH-nyos des-PWES, KWAN-do por feen leh kon-seh-DYEH-ron el TEE-too-lo no-bee-LYAH-ryo.
choices.english: I read it was added years later, when he was finally granted noble status.
choices.feedback: Sharp historical recall expressed in seamless formal Spanish.

choices.text: No conocía ese detalle; ¿qué implicaciones tenía para un pintor de corte del siglo diecisiete?
choices.phonetic: No ko-no-SEE-ah EH-seh deh-TAH-yeh; keh eem-plee-kah-SYO-nes teh-NEE-ah PAH-rah oon peen-TOR deh KOR-teh del SEE-glo dyeh-see-SYEH-teh?
choices.english: I didn't know that detail; what did that signify for a seventeenth-century court painter?
choices.feedback: Thoughtful, inquisitive dialogue.

nodes.npcText: De cerca parecen manchas casi impresionistas, pero a tres metros el brocado brilla como seda auténtica.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Deh SEHR-kah pah-REH-sen MAN-chas KAH-see eem-preh-syo-NEES-tas, PEH-ro ah tres MEH-tros el bro-KAH-do BREE-yah KO-mo SEH-dah ah-oo-TEN-tee-kah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Up close they look like almost Impressionist dabs, yet from three meters away the brocade gleams like real silk.

choices.text: No extraña que siglos después pintores como Manet y Picasso quedaran obsesionados con este cuadro.
choices.phonetic: No eks-TRAH-nyah keh SEE-glos des-PWES peen-TO-res KO-mo mah-NET ee pee-KAH-so keh-DAH-ran ob-seh-syo-NAH-dos kon ES-teh KWAH-dro.
choices.english: No wonder centuries later painters like Manet and Picasso became obsessed with this canvas.
choices.feedback: Impressive imperfect subjunctive ('quedaran') after 'no extraña que'!

choices.text: ¿Qué otra sala del museo recomendaría visitar enseguida para apreciar esa evolución técnica?
choices.phonetic: Keh O-trah SAH-lah del moo-SEH-o reh-ko-men-dah-REE-ah vee-see-TAR en-seh-GEE-dah PAH-rah ah-preh-SYAR EH-sah eh-vo-loo-SYON TEK-nee-kah?
choices.english: Which other gallery would you recommend visiting next to appreciate that technical evolution?
choices.feedback: Articulate and curious follow-up.

nodes.npcText: Así es: con este cuadro Velázquez defendió que la pintura era un arte liberal y no un mero oficio artesanal.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-SEE es: kon ES-teh KWAH-dro veh-LAS-kes deh-fen-DYO keh lah peen-TOO-rah EH-rah oon AR-teh lee-beh-RAL ee no oon MEH-ro o-FEE-syo ar-teh-sah-NAL.
nodes.npcEnglish: Indeed: with this painting Velázquez argued that painting was a liberal art and not merely manual craft.

choices.text: Esa perspectiva transforma por completo la manera de mirar el autorretrato. Muchísimas gracias.
choices.phonetic: EH-sah pehrs-pek-TEE-vah trans-FOR-mah por kom-PLEH-to lah mah-NEH-rah deh mee-RAR el ah-oo-to-rreh-TRAH-to. Moo-CHEE-see-mas GRAH-syas.
choices.english: That perspective completely transforms how you look at the self-portrait. Thank you so much.
choices.feedback: Thoughtful, elevated, and deeply appreciative.

choices.text: Qué privilegio poder contemplarlo en directo sin prisas. Gracias por compartir su análisis.
choices.phonetic: Keh pree-vee-LEH-hyo po-DEHR kon-tem-PLAR-lo en dee-REK-to seen PREE-sas. GRAH-syas por kom-par-TEER soo ah-NAH-lee-sees.
choices.english: What a privilege to view it in person unhurriedly. Thanks for sharing your analysis.
choices.feedback: Warm and refined.

nodes.npcText: Le sugiero pasar luego a las Pinturas Negras de Goya para vivir el contraste más sobrecogedor del Prado.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Leh soo-HYEH-ro pah-SAR LWEH-go ah las peen-TOO-ras NEH-gras deh GO-yah PAH-rah vee-VEER el kon-TRAS-teh mas so-breh-ko-heh-DOR del PRAH-do.
nodes.npcEnglish: I suggest heading next to Goya's Black Paintings for the Prado's most breathtaking contrast.

choices.text: Haré exactamente ese recorrido; es un diálogo fascinante entre dos épocas.
choices.phonetic: Ah-REH ek-sak-tah-MEN-teh EH-seh reh-ko-RREE-do; es oon DYAH-lo-go fas-see-NAN-teh EN-treh dos EH-po-kas.
choices.english: I'll follow that exact route; it's a fascinating dialogue between two eras.
choices.feedback: Eloquent cultural reflection.

choices.text: Anoto su sugerencia, mil gracias por enriquecer tanto la visita.
choices.phonetic: Ah-NO-to soo soo-heh-REN-syah, meel GRAH-syas por en-ree-keh-SEHR TAN-to lah vee-SEE-tah.
choices.english: I'll note your suggestion, a thousand thanks for enriching the visit so much.
choices.feedback: Gracious and poised.

nodes.npcText: Ha sido un placer conversar con alguien tan observador. ¡Que siga disfrutando del museo!
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah SEE-do oon plah-SEHR kon-vehr-SAR kon AL-gyen tan ob-sehr-vah-DOR. Keh SEE-gah dees-froo-TAN-do del moo-SEH-o!
nodes.npcEnglish: It's been a pleasure conversing with someone so observant. Continue enjoying the museum!

title: Creative Agency Interview
setting: A final-round interview for a bilingual product design role in central Madrid.

nodes.npcText: Muchas gracias por venir. Nos impresionó tu portafolio; cuéntanos cómo abordas un proyecto cuando el enfoque inicial no está claro.
nodes.npcPhonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas por veh-NEER. Nos eem-preh-syo-NO too por-tah-FO-lyo; KWEN-tah-nos KO-mo ah-BOR-das oon pro-YEK-to KWAN-do el en-FO-keh ee-nee-SYAL no es-TAH KLAH-ro.
nodes.npcEnglish: Thank you for coming. Your portfolio impressed us; tell us how you approach a project when the initial brief is unclear.

choices.text: Empiezo alineando objetivos con el cliente y validando hipótesis rápidas antes de invertir semanas en detalle visual.
choices.phonetic: Em-PYEH-so ah-lee-neh-AN-do ob-heh-TEE-vos kon el KLYEN-teh ee vah-lee-DAN-do ee-PO-teh-sees RAH-pee-das AN-tes deh een-vehr-TEER seh-MAH-nas en deh-TAH-yeh vee-SWAL.
choices.english: I start by aligning goals with the client and validating quick hypotheses before investing weeks in visual polish.
choices.feedback: Crisp, senior-level product Spanish with clear methodology!

choices.text: Suelo entrevistar primero a usuarios finales para que las decisiones se apoyen en datos y no en suposiciones.
choices.phonetic: SWEH-lo en-treh-vees-TAR pree-MEH-ro ah oo-SWAH-ryos fee-NAH-les PAH-rah keh las deh-see-SYO-nes seh ah-PO-yen en DAH-tos ee no en soo-po-see-SYO-nes.
choices.english: I usually interview end users first so decisions rest on evidence rather than assumptions.
choices.feedback: Great use of 'para que + subjunctive' ('se apoyen').

nodes.npcText: Ese criterio nos encaja mucho. ¿Cómo manejas el desacuerdo si un cliente insiste en una solución poco usable?
nodes.npcPhonetic: EH-seh kree-TEH-ryo nos en-KAH-hah MOO-cho. KO-mo mah-NEH-has el deh-sah-KWEHR-do see oon KLYEN-teh een-SEES-teh en OO-nah so-loo-SYON PO-ko oo-SAH-bleh?
nodes.npcEnglish: That mindset fits us well. How do you handle disagreement if a client insists on an unusable solution?

choices.text: Evito llevarlo al terreno personal: propongo probar ambas opciones con cinco usuarios y dejar que los resultados hablen.
choices.phonetic: Eh-VEE-to yeh-VAR-lo al teh-RREH-no pehr-so-NAL: pro-POHN-go pro-BAR AM-bas op-SYO-nes kon SEEN-ko oo-SWAH-ryos ee deh-HAR keh los reh-sool-TAH-dos AH-blen.
choices.english: I avoid making it personal: I propose testing both options with five users and letting results speak.
choices.feedback: Diplomatic, persuasive, and idiomatic ('llevarlo al terreno personal')!

choices.text: Primero escucho la restricción de negocio detrás de su petición y luego presento alternativas viables.
choices.phonetic: Pree-MEH-ro es-KOO-cho lah res-treek-SYON deh neh-GO-syo deh-TRAS deh soo peh-tee-SYON ee LWEH-go preh-SEN-to al-tehr-nah-TEE-vas VYAH-bles.
choices.english: First I listen to the business constraint behind their request, then present viable alternatives.
choices.feedback: Mature stakeholder communication in fluent Spanish.

nodes.npcText: Excelente enfoque. Trabajamos en equipos bilingües entre Madrid y Ciudad de México; ¿qué tal te desenvuelves en remoto?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ek-seh-LEN-teh en-FO-keh. Trah-bah-HAH-mos en eh-KEE-pos bee-LEEN-gwes EN-treh mah-DREED ee syoo-DAD deh MEH-hee-ko; keh tal teh deh-sen-VWEL-ves en reh-MO-to?
nodes.npcEnglish: Excellent approach. We work in bilingual teams across Madrid and Mexico City; how do you thrive remotely?

choices.text: Muy bien: documento acuerdos por escrito para respetar husos horarios y reservo las llamadas para decisiones clave.
choices.phonetic: Mwee byen: do-koo-MEN-to ah-KWEHR-dos por es-KREE-to PAH-rah res-peh-TAR OO-sos o-RAH-ryos ee reh-SEHR-vo las yah-MAH-das PAH-rah deh-see-SYO-nes KLAH-veh.
choices.english: Very well: I document agreements in writing to respect time zones and reserve calls for key decisions.
choices.feedback: Sharp remote-work leadership vocabulary ('husos horarios').

choices.text: Me encanta la dinámica híbrida: valoro la colaboración presencial para arrancar fases creativas.
choices.phonetic: Meh en-KAN-tah lah dee-NAH-mee-kah EE-bree-dah: vah-LO-ro lah ko-lah-bo-rah-SYON preh-sen-SYAL PAH-rah ah-rran-KAR FAH-ses kreh-ah-TEE-vas.
choices.english: I love hybrid rhythms: I value in-person collaboration to kick off creative phases.
choices.feedback: Balanced, articulate preference.

nodes.npcText: Justo esa madurez buscábamos. Antes de cerrar, ¿qué pregunta te gustaría hacernos sobre el puesto o el equipo?
nodes.npcPhonetic: HOOS-to EH-sah mah-doo-RES boos-KAH-bah-mos. AN-tes deh seh-RRAR, keh preh-GOON-tah teh goos-tah-REE-ah ah-SEHR-nos SO-breh el PWES-to o el eh-KEE-po?
nodes.npcEnglish: That's the exact maturity we were looking for. Before we wrap up, what question would you like to ask us?

choices.text: ¿Qué debería haber logrado quien ocupe este puesto en sus primeros noventa días para considerarlo un éxito?
choices.phonetic: Keh deh-beh-REE-ah ah-BEHR lo-GRAH-do kyen o-KOO-peh ES-teh PWES-to en soos pree-MEH-ros no-VEN-tah DEE-as PAH-rah kon-see-deh-RAR-lo oon EK-see-to?
choices.english: What should the person in this role have achieved in their first ninety days for it to be deemed a success?
choices.feedback: High-impact interview question with flawless compound conditional + subjunctive!

choices.text: ¿Cómo fomentan la colaboración continua entre diseño, producto e ingeniería en el día a día?
choices.phonetic: KO-mo fo-MEN-tan lah ko-lah-bo-rah-SYON kon-TEE-nwah EN-treh dee-SEH-nyo, pro-DOOK-to eh een-heh-nyeh-REE-ah en el DEE-ah ah DEE-ah?
choices.english: How do you foster ongoing collaboration between design, product, and engineering day to day?
choices.feedback: Thoughtful culture question ('en el día a día').

nodes.npcText: Nos encantaría contar con alguien que aporte esa claridad. ¿Tienes alguna duda sobre las siguientes fases del proceso?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Nos en-kan-tah-REE-ah kon-TAR kon AL-gyen keh ah-POR-teh EH-sah klah-ree-DAD. TYEH-nes al-GOO-nah DOO-dah SO-breh las see-GYEN-tes FAH-ses del pro-SEH-so?
nodes.npcEnglish: We'd love to have someone who brings that clarity. Do you have any questions about next steps in the process?

choices.text: Solo saber en qué plazos prevén tomar una decisión y si necesitan alguna referencia adicional.
choices.phonetic: SO-lo sah-BEHR en keh PLAH-sos preh-VEN to-MAR OO-nah deh-see-SYON ee see neh-seh-SEE-tan al-GOO-nah reh-feh-REN-syah ah-dee-syo-NAL.
choices.english: Just to know your expected decision timeline and whether you need any additional references.
choices.feedback: Professional, concise, and proactive.

choices.text: Todo quedó muy claro; muchas gracias por una conversación tan estimulante.
choices.phonetic: TO-do keh-DO mwee KLAH-ro; MOO-chas GRAH-syas por OO-nah kon-vehr-sah-SYON tan es-tee-moo-LAN-teh.
choices.english: Everything is very clear; thank you for such a stimulating conversation.
choices.feedback: Warm, confident sign-off.

nodes.npcText: El éxito en tres meses sería liderar el rediseño con datos reales. Te escribimos este viernes con respuesta.
nodes.npcPhonetic: El EK-see-to en tres MEH-ses seh-REE-ah lee-deh-RAR el reh-dee-SEH-nyo kon DAH-tos reh-AH-les. Teh es-kree-BEE-mos ES-teh VYEHR-nes kon res-PWES-tah.
nodes.npcEnglish: Success in three months would be leading the redesign with real data. We'll write to you this Friday with our answer.

title: Resolving a Hotel Billing Error
setting: A refined boutique hotel front desk in Seville during morning check-out.

nodes.npcText: Buenos días. Aquí tiene el desglose de su factura para la habitación trescientos dos. ¿Desea cargarlo a la misma tarjeta?
nodes.npcPhonetic: BWEH-nos DEE-as. Ah-KEE TYEH-neh el des-GLO-seh deh soo fak-TOO-rah PAH-rah lah ah-bee-tah-SYON tres-SYEN-tos dos. Deh-SEH-ah kar-GAR-lo ah lah MEES-mah tar-HEH-tah?
nodes.npcEnglish: Good morning. Here is your itemized bill for room 302. Would you like to charge the same card?

choices.text: Disculpe, acabo de revisar el desglose y figuran dos cargos de minibar que no consumí.
choices.phonetic: Dees-KOOL-peh, ah-KAH-bo deh reh-vee-SAR el des-GLO-seh ee fee-GOO-ran dos KAR-gos deh mee-nee-BAR keh no kon-soo-MEE.
choices.english: Excuse me, I just reviewed the breakdown and there are two minibar charges I didn't consume.
choices.feedback: Firm yet polite—'desglose' and 'figuran cargos' sound effortlessly composed.

choices.text: Creo que hay un pequeño error: mi reserva incluía el desayuno y aquí aparece facturado aparte.
choices.phonetic: KREH-o keh eye oon peh-KEH-nyo eh-RROR: mee reh-SEHR-vah een-kloo-EE-ah el deh-sah-YOO-no ee ah-KEE ah-pah-REH-seh fak-too-RAH-do ah-PAR-teh.
choices.english: I believe there's a small mistake: my booking included breakfast and here it's billed separately.
choices.feedback: Courteous and factual—avoids sounding accusatory.

nodes.npcText: Le pido mil disculpas, déjeme comprobar el parte de pisos… Efectivamente, corresponde a la habitación trescientos doce.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Leh PEE-do meel dees-KOOL-pas, DEH-heh-meh kom-pro-BAR el PAR-teh deh PEE-sos... Eh-fek-tee-vah-MEN-teh, ko-rres-POHN-deh ah lah ah-bee-tah-SYON tres-SYEN-tos DO-seh.
nodes.npcEnglish: A thousand apologies, let me check the housekeeping log... Indeed, that belongs to room 312.

choices.text: No pasa nada, un baile de números le ocurre a cualquiera. ¿Me emite la factura corregida?
choices.phonetic: No PAH-sah NAH-dah, oon BY-leh deh NOO-meh-ros leh o-KOO-rreh ah kwal-KYEH-rah. Meh eh-MEE-teh lah fak-TOO-rah ko-rreh-HEE-dah?
choices.english: No worries, a digit mix-up happens to anyone. Could you issue the corrected invoice?
choices.feedback: Classy Spanish idiom: 'baile de números' (transposed digits)!

choices.text: Gracias por verificarlo tan rápido. ¿Podría enviármela también por correo en PDF para mis gastos?
choices.phonetic: GRAH-syas por veh-ree-fee-KAR-lo tan RAH-pee-do. Po-DREE-ah en-VYAR-meh-lah tam-BYEN por ko-RREH-o en peh-deh-EH-feh PAH-rah mees GAS-tos?
choices.english: Thanks for checking so fast. Could you also email it as a PDF for my expense report?
choices.feedback: Practical business-travel request.

nodes.npcText: Tiene usted toda la razón; al cambiar la tarifa no se vinculó el régimen de desayuno incluido. Lo anulo de inmediato.
nodes.npcPhonetic: TYEH-neh oos-TED TO-dah lah rah-SON; al kam-BYAR lah tah-REE-fah no seh veen-koo-LO el REH-hee-men deh deh-sah-YOO-no een-kloo-EE-do. Lo ah-NOO-lo deh een-meh-DYAH-to.
nodes.npcEnglish: You're completely right; when the rate updated, the breakfast-included plan didn't link. I'll void it right away.

choices.text: Se lo agradezco mucho. Además, ¿podría desglosar el IVA para mi contabilidad?
choices.phonetic: Seh lo ah-grah-DES-ko MOO-cho. Ah-deh-MAS, po-DREE-ah des-glo-SAR el EE-vah PAH-rah mee kon-tah-bee-lee-DAD?
choices.english: I appreciate that very much. Also, could you break out the VAT for my accounting?
choices.feedback: Exact business Spanish ('desglosar el IVA').

choices.text: Estupendo, así queda todo cuadrado. ¿También anula la retención previa en la tarjeta?
choices.phonetic: Es-too-PEN-do, ah-SEE KEH-dah TO-do kwah-DRAH-do. Tam-BYEN ah-NOO-lah lah reh-ten-SYON PREH-vyah en lah tar-HEH-tah?
choices.english: Wonderful, that squares everything up. Does that also release the pre-authorization hold on my card?
choices.feedback: Savvy and idiomatic ('quedar cuadrado', 'retención previa').

nodes.npcText: Aquí tiene la factura rectificada con el IVA desglosado y el importe exacto. Sentimos mucho las molestias.
nodes.npcPhonetic: Ah-KEE TYEH-neh lah fak-TOO-rah rek-tee-fee-KAH-dah kon el EE-vah des-glo-SAH-do ee el eem-POR-teh ek-SAK-to. Sen-TEE-mos MOO-cho las mo-LES-tyas.
nodes.npcEnglish: Here is the corrected invoice with VAT itemized and the exact total. We're very sorry for the inconvenience.

choices.text: Todo perfecto ahora. Por lo demás, la estancia ha sido impecable y volveré con gusto.
choices.phonetic: TO-do pehr-FEK-to ah-O-rah. Por lo deh-MAS, lah es-TAN-syah ah SEE-do eem-peh-KAH-bleh ee vol-veh-REH kon GOOS-to.
choices.english: All perfect now. Otherwise, my stay has been impeccable and I'll gladly return.
choices.feedback: Graceful closing using 'por lo demás' (for the rest / otherwise).

choices.text: Muchas gracias por resolverlo con tanta eficacia. ¿Nos puede pedir un taxi a la estación?
choices.phonetic: MOO-chas GRAH-syas por reh-sol-VEHR-lo kon TAN-tah eh-fee-KAH-syah. Nos PWEH-deh peh-DEER oon TAK-see ah lah es-tah-SYON?
choices.english: Thank you very much for resolving it so efficiently. Could you call us a taxi to the station?
choices.feedback: Smooth pivot to your next travel step.

nodes.npcText: Listo, la copia PDF ya salió hacia su correo y la retención original queda liberada hoy mismo.
nodes.npcPhonetic: LEES-to, lah KO-pyah peh-deh-EH-feh yah sah-LYO AH-syah soo ko-RREH-o ee lah reh-ten-SYON o-ree-hee-NAL KEH-dah lee-beh-RAH-dah oy MEES-mo.
nodes.npcEnglish: Done, the PDF copy is on its way to your email and the original hold is released today.

choices.text: Excelente atención, así da gusto viajar. ¡Hasta la próxima!
choices.phonetic: Ek-seh-LEN-teh ah-ten-SYON, ah-SEE dah GOOS-to vyah-HAR. AH-stah lah PROK-see-mah!
choices.english: Excellent service, this makes traveling a pleasure. Until next time!
choices.feedback: Great native expression: 'así da gusto...'!

choices.text: Acabo de recibirlo, mil gracias por la diligencia.
choices.phonetic: Ah-KAH-bo deh reh-see-BEER-lo, meel GRAH-syas por lah dee-lee-HEN-syah.
choices.english: I just received it, a thousand thanks for your promptness.
choices.feedback: Polished and courteous.

nodes.npcText: El taxi estará en la puerta en tres minutos. ¡Buen viaje de regreso y gracias por su comprensión!
nodes.npcPhonetic: El TAK-see es-tah-RAH en lah PWER-tah en tres mee-NOO-tos. Bwen VYAH-heh deh reh-GREH-so ee GRAH-syas por soo kom-pren-SYON!
nodes.npcEnglish: The taxi will be at the door in three minutes. Safe trip back and thank you for your understanding!

title: Neighborhood Sustainability Forum
setting: An open civic roundtable at a cultural center discussing greener urban plazas.

nodes.npcText: Gracias por asistir al foro vecinal. Queremos recoger propuestas para reducir el calor veraniego en nuestras plazas.
nodes.npcPhonetic: GRAH-syas por ah-sees-TEER al FO-ro veh-see-NAL. Keh-REH-mos reh-ko-HEHR pro-PWES-tas PAH-rah reh-doo-SEER el kah-LOR veh-rah-NYEH-go en NWES-tras PLAH-sas.
nodes.npcEnglish: Thanks for attending the neighborhood forum. We want to gather proposals to reduce summer heat in our plazas.

choices.text: Creo que sustituir parte del pavimento duro por arbolado autóctono y fuentes cambiaría el microclima.
choices.phonetic: KREH-o keh soos-tee-TWEER PAR-teh del pah-vee-MEN-to DOO-ro por ar-bo-LAH-do ah-oo-TOK-to-no ee FWEN-tes kam-byah-REE-ah el mee-kro-KLEE-mah.
choices.english: I think replacing part of the hard paving with native trees and fountains would transform the microclimate.
choices.feedback: Eloquent civic Spanish ('arbolado autóctono', 'microclima')!

choices.text: Además de sombra, convendría ampliar los carriles bici conectados para disminuir el tráfico de paso.
choices.phonetic: Ah-deh-MAS deh SOM-brah, kon-ven-DREE-ah am-PLYAR los kah-RREE-les BEE-see ko-nek-TAH-dos PAH-rah dees-mee-NWEER el TRAH-fee-ko deh PAH-so.
choices.english: Beyond shade, it would help to expand connected bike lanes to cut through-traffic.
choices.feedback: Constructive and concise ('convendría', 'tráfico de paso').

nodes.npcText: Muy buen punto. Algunos comerciantes temen que menos plazas de aparcamiento afecten sus ventas; ¿cómo lo ve?
nodes.npcPhonetic: Mwee bwen POON-to. Al-GOO-nos ko-mehr-SYAN-tes TEH-men keh MEH-nos PLAH-sas deh ah-par-kah-MYEN-to ah-FEK-ten soos VEN-tas; KO-mo lo veh?
nodes.npcEnglish: Very good point. Some shopkeepers fear fewer parking spaces might hurt sales; how do you see it?

choices.text: Es una inquietud legítima, pero los estudios en calles peatonalizadas muestran que al aumentar el paseo sube el comercio local.
choices.phonetic: Es OO-nah een-kyeh-TOOD leh-HEE-tee-mah, PEH-ro los es-TOO-dyos en KAH-yes peh-ah-to-nah-lee-SAH-das MWES-tran keh al ah-oo-men-TAR el pah-SEH-o SOO-beh el ko-MEHR-syo lo-KAL.
choices.english: That's a legitimate concern, yet studies on pedestrianized streets show more foot traffic boosts local shops.
choices.feedback: Nuanced, empathetic counter-argument backed by evidence!

choices.text: Podríamos pactar zonas de carga y descarga bien reguladas por la mañana para apoyar a los comercios.
choices.phonetic: Po-DREE-ah-mos pak-TAR SO-nas deh KAR-gah ee des-KAR-gah byen reh-goo-LAH-das por lah mah-NYAH-nah PAH-rah ah-po-YAR ah los ko-MEHR-syos.
choices.english: We could agree on well-regulated morning loading zones to support the businesses.
choices.feedback: Collaborative solution-building ('pactar', 'carga y descarga').

nodes.npcText: Totalmente cierto. El reto es conectar la red ciclista con los colegios y mercados sin restar espacio peatonal.
nodes.npcPhonetic: To-tal-MEN-teh SYEHR-to. El REH-to es ko-nek-TAR lah red see-KLEES-tah kon los ko-LEH-hyos ee mehr-KAH-dos seen res-TAR es-PAH-syo peh-ah-to-NAL.
nodes.npcEnglish: Completely true. The challenge is linking the cycling network to schools and markets without shrinking sidewalk space.

choices.text: Si el carril se segrega en la calzada y no en la acera, ganan en seguridad tanto peatones como ciclistas.
